items.title: What’s new with Grafana variables: less clutter, easier reuse across dashboards, and more
items.summary: Template variables are one of the most used features in Grafana, providing users with a dropdown to turn one dashboard into hundreds: pick a different cluster , region , or service , and every panel updates. For most of Grafana's history, variables had a single home at the top of the dashboard. Each dashboard had one flat list of variables, and that list was shared by every panel on it. But as dashboards grew in size and number, those controls became harder to organize and maintain. The top of a dashboard could get crowded with dropdowns that only applied to certain panels, while shared controls were copied across dashboards and had to be updated individually. To address these challenges, we’ve rolled out two new features in Grafana: Section-level variables for rows and tabs (generally available): these variables let you place controls near the panels they affect, reducing clutter at the top of the dashboard. items.title: Prometheus v3.16.0
items.summary: - [CHANGE] API: The experimental search endpoints now clamp batch size to 1000. 19731
items.release_notes:
- [CHANGE] API: The experimental search endpoints now clamp `batch_size` to 1000. #19731
- [CHANGE] Configuration: Default --web.external-url to https when --web.config.file enables TLS. #19241
- [CHANGE] PromQL: Subquery samples are now included in the query TotalSamples and TotalSamplesPerStep statistics, and SamplesRead now counts reads from subqueries with an @ modifier in range queries. #19165
- [CHANGE] Remote write: Stop exposing the deprecated `prometheus_remote_storage_metadata_total`, `prometheus_remote_storage_metadata_failed_total`, `prometheus_remote_storage_metadata_retried_total`, and `prometheus_remote_storage_metadata_bytes_total` metrics for Remote Write 2.0 queues. #20080
- [CHANGE] Remote write receiver: Count Remote Write 2.x samples and histograms ingested without metadata in `prometheus_api_remote_write_without_metadata_appended_samples_total` even when `metadata-wal-records` is disabled. #19812
- [CHANGE] TSDB: Reject exemplars whose label names are not unique, instead of storing them and serving a duplicate JSON key from `/api/v1/query_exemplars`. #19896
- [FEATURE] API: Allow overriding PromQL Start Timestamp processing on a per-query basis using the `X-Prometheus-Use-Start-Timestamps` HTTP header. #19066
- [FEATURE] Agent: Support metadata-wal-records in Prometheus Agent mode. #19684
- [FEATURE] PromQL: Add experimental `integral()` function for computing integral-over-time of range vectors behind the `--enable-feature=promql-experimental-functions` flag. #14440
- [FEATURE] PromQL: Add experimental query cost estimation, actual cost reporting, and configurable execution limits, enabled with `--enable-feature=query-cost`. #20028
- [FEATURE] PromQL: Smoothed and Anchored vector selectors are now stable and always-on. #19697
- [FEATURE] PromQL: Use start timestamps to detect counter resets when float timeseries are queried using extended range selector modifiers (`anchored`, `smoothed`). This feature is hidden behind `use-start-timestamps` feature flag. #18966
- [FEATURE] Promtool: print test filename during promtool tests #18271
- [FEATURE] PromQL: Allow unquoted Unicode letters and dots behind a feature flag #20162
- [ENHANCEMENT] Search API: Warn when participating remote-read storage does not support search. #19992
- [ENHANCEMENT] Remote Read: Add native histogram prometheus_remote_read_handler_gate_wait_duration_seconds to measure concurrency-gate wait duration, including requests canceled while waiting. #18355
- [ENHANCEMENT] Remote Write: Add experimental flag `convert_nhcb_to_classic` to convert NHCB to classic histograms for external systems that dont support NHCBs. #17205
- [ENHANCEMENT] promtool: Add `--allow-incompatible-block-duration` so users can specify any max-block-duration instead of being restricted to the default Prometheus block durations. #19363
- [PERF] Remote write: Cache repeated OTLP histogram metric names. #19717
- [PERF] OpenMetrics 2.0 parser: Reuse classic histogram and summary expansion buffers across scrapes. #19907
- [PERF] PromQL: Decode only histogram sum/count (not buckets) for timestamp(), start_timestamp() and absent(). #19738
- [PERF] PromQL: Only select the fixed window for subqueries with an `@` modifier. #19863
- [PERF] Remote write / TSDB: Deduplicate per-series metadata structs in memory with `unique.Handle`. #20040
- [PERF] Scrape: Avoid some copies of scrape response bodies. #19394
- [PERF] TSDB: Improve XOR2 compression and append performance by selecting value windows based on encoding cost. #19962
- [PERF] TSDB: Reduce memory used writing and reading checkpoint metadata records. #19712
- [PERF] Scrape: Convert classic histograms to NHCB directly in the OpenMetrics 2.0 parser without wrapping in `NHCBParser`. #19880
- [PERF] Scrape: Reduce OpenMetrics 2.0 parser allocations and CPU overhead by lazily constructing composite series and exemplar labels. #19895
- [BUGFIX] Remote read: Abort failed streaming responses without writing duplicate headers or appending plain-text errors to the protobuf stream #19749
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix loss of out-of-order samples when a WAL checkpoint drops a series record that the out-of-order write-behind log still needs #19737
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix queries that seek within a head chunk returning samples committed after the query started #19854
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Preserve mapped chunks when WAL replay merges multiple references for the same series, preventing missing out-of-order samples and duplicate in-order chunks after restart #19805
- [BUGFIX] Fix auto-reload logic to reload after reverting a failed configuration change #19838
- [BUGFIX] API: Do not match metric family metadata for doubled _total and _info suffixes in experimental search API. #19910
- [BUGFIX] API: Reject `timeout` and `lookback_delta` values that overflow int64 instead of turning them into a negative duration #19658
- [BUGFIX] API: Resolve metric family metadata for suffixed metric names in search results, in experimental search API. #19824
- [BUGFIX] AWS SD: Describe each ElastiCache cluster once instead of twice for clusters that are not replication group members. #19434
- [BUGFIX] Build: Allow installing promtool with version-suffixed go install commands #19754
- [BUGFIX] Discovery: Fix a panic in Azure service discovery when a VM tag has a null value. #19755
- [BUGFIX] Federation: fix corruption of float native histograms. #19679
- [BUGFIX] Fix ts_of_last_over_time for samples before the Unix epoch. #19828
- [BUGFIX] Histograms: Fix ConvertNHCBToClassic inflating classic bucket counts for integer native histograms whose spans have gaps. #19659
- [BUGFIX] Logging: Preserve rule and TSDB block values in JSON logs. #19572
- [BUGFIX] OTLP receiver: Drop exemplars with timestamps more than 10 minutes in the future instead of storing them and blocking subsequent exemplars for that series. #19812
- [BUGFIX] OTLP: Count only out-of-order exemplars in `prometheus_api_otlp_out_of_order_exemplars_total`, not every rejected exemplar. #20030
- [BUGFIX] OTLP: Do not drop exemplars that have a `trace_id` or `span_id` filtered attribute in addition to a trace or span ID. The trace context now takes precedence over the colliding attribute, as required by the OpenTelemetry specification. #20004
- [BUGFIX] OTLP: Do not emit `le="+Inf"` twice when a histogram's explicit bounds end at `+Inf`, and warn about the bound. #19425
- [BUGFIX] OTLP: Stop dropping exemplars that arrive out of timestamp order within a data point. #20029
- [BUGFIX] OpenMetrics 2.0: Attach histogram exemplars to matching classic `_bucket` series and preserve them when scraping both native and classic histograms. #20020
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Avoid intermediate overflow in `rad()` and `deg()` conversions. #19901
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Consistently ignore and drop `__type__` and `__unit__` labels in `without` aggregations, `absent()`, `info()`, and binary operator fill matching. #19986
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Do not panic when printing the partial AST returned alongside a parse error. #19797
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Drop __type__ and __unit__ in binary operations so they are transparent to users, similar to how __name__ is handled. #18680
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix `==`, `!=`, `changes()` and `count_values` on native histograms giving wrong results inside `histogram_count()`, `histogram_sum()` and `histogram_avg()`. #20024
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix histogram_fraction returning wrong results for native histograms with custom buckets when a bucket boundary is exactly 0. #19657
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix histogram_quantile and histogram_quantiles interpolating within the wrong bucket for native histograms whose sum is NaN. #19973
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix lexing of subqueries whose range is a duration keyword expression, e.g. `foo[range():1s]`. #19729
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix warning and error locations for duration expressions `min_of` and `max_of`. #19742
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Ignore NaN classic histogram bucket boundaries in `histogram_quantile`, `histogram_quantiles` and `histogram_fraction` and return correct value instead of NaN if there are normal buckets. #20057
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Preserve infinite values at exact quantile ranks. #19899
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Preserve original operand sides for experimental fill modifiers with group_right matching. #19939
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Preserve subquery step expressions when printing queries after preprocessing. #19743
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Range vector functions no longer raise a spurious "vector cannot contain metrics with the same labelset" error when series have different metric names but the same remaining labels, as long as their timestamps do not overlap within the evaluated range window #18631
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: do not count subquery materialized samples in total samples statistics #19873
- [BUGFIX] Remote write: Prevent future-dated exemplars from scaling shards down to the minimum. #19866
- [BUGFIX] Agent: Prevent future sent timestamps from advancing WAL truncation beyond the minimum retention window. #19866
- [BUGFIX] Rules: Restore firing alerts with for durations shorter than --rules.alert.for-grace-period after a restart. #19882
- [BUGFIX] Scrape: fix failing scrape when float histogram is emitted over protobuf with count, zero count and buckets all zero, for example a result of recording `rate(x[1m])` over constant histogram. #19682
- [BUGFIX] Search API: Return the lexically smallest label values when `limit` is set on `/api/v1/search/label_values`, instead of an arbitrary subset #19694
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix WAL watcher permanently skipping checkpoint series garbage collection when lagging behind head truncation. #20041
- [BUGFIX] Search API: Avoid panics when the requested time range has no participating storage. #19992
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix a race in selected-series and stale-series compaction where a sample committed after the block was written but before the series was evicted from the head could be silently lost. The fix no longer depends on isolation being enabled. #19666
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix a rare case where a sample could be lost during selected-series or stale-series compaction if an unrelated write to the same series ran cleanup that erased the evidence needed to protect it. #19672
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix spurious "unknown series references" warnings during WAL replay after a restart, when the only blocks on disk were produced by selected-series or stale-series compaction. #19734
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Increment `prometheus_tsdb_wal_corruptions_total` when WAL corruption is detected during checkpoint creation, so the metric reflects corruption found at compaction time rather than only after a restart-triggered repair. #19858
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Preserve series identities needed to recover exemplars after compaction and restart. #19940
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Reject native histograms whose span offsets overflow the int32 bucket index instead of storing them with corrupted buckets. #20034
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: fix no passing metadata-wal-records to TSDB from main feature flag. #19678
- [BUGFIX] Templates: Preserve IPv6 addresses with dotted zone identifiers in `stripDomain`. #19908
- [BUGFIX] UI: Don't automatically open an autocomplete dropdown after closing a function call body or aggregation operator with a closing parenthesis. #19825
- [BUGFIX] Web: Fix HTTP/2 negotiation silently falling back to HTTP/1.1 under Go 1.27+ when TLS is enabled with `http2: true`. The server now correctly advertises `h2` via ALPN and multiplexes concurrent requests over a single connection. #19848
- [BUGFIX] mixin: Fix double-counting of failed samples in the `PrometheusRemoteStorageFailures` alert denominator. #19877
- [BUGFIX] promtool: Honor `--enable-feature` when evaluating rules in `test rules`. #20046
- [BUGFIX] Scrape: Ensure UTF-8 works with the experimental OpenMetrics 2.0 #19902
- [BUGFIX] Scrape: Reject sum-only classic histograms during NHCB conversion #19315

items.title: Announcing the OpenTelemetry JavaScript SDK 3.0
items.summary: OpenTelemetry JavaScript has released SDK 3.0 ( stable v3.0.0 packages and experimental v0.300.0 packages ) and API 1.10.0 . Migration guide For a detailed description of breaking changes, see the OpenTelemetry JS SDK 3.x migration guide . What is JS SDK 3.x? JS SDK 3.x encompasses new releases of the @opentelemetry/ JavaScript packages published from the opentelemetry-js repository , except the API and semantic-conventions packages. The package versions for this new major will be >=3.0.0 for the stable and >=0.300.0 for the unstable packages. Details on the full list of packages can be found in the migration guide .

items.title: Jaeger v2.23.0
items.summary: Backend Changes
items.release_notes:
### Backend Changes

#### ⛔ Breaking Changes

* Fix(storage): remove unused clickhouse feature gates ([@albertteoh](https://github.com/albertteoh) in [#9988](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9988))
* Fix(storage): resolve auth extension references deterministically ([@jkowall](https://github.com/jkowall) in [#9772](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9772))
* Chore(ai-sidecar): remove the gemini reference sidecar ([@alishair7071](https://github.com/alishair7071) in [#9841](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9841))
* Feat(clickhouse): require an explicit table engine when creating the schema ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9813](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9813))

#### ✨ New Features

* Feat(mcp): accept a sql statement in the search_traces tool ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9925](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9925))
* Feat(query): add a sql query surface that compiles to rfc 0005 filters ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9922](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9922))
* Feat(query): serve storage search capabilities over api_v3 http ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9804](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9804))
* Feat(query): serve storage search capabilities over api_v3 grpc ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9803](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9803))
* Build(idl): bump jaeger-idl to v0.14.0 ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9802](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9802))
* Feat(clickhouse): route structured query filters to sql where (rfc 0005 m3) ([@om7057](https://github.com/om7057) in [#9701](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9701))

#### 🐞 Bug fixes, Minor Improvements

* Fix(mcp): start the investigation strategy with read_skill ([@lopster568](https://github.com/lopster568) in [#10038](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/10038))

* Fix(es): store non-finite doubles as otlp/json string tags ([@jkowall](https://github.com/jkowall) in [#9912](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9912))
* Fix(query): deduplicate shared span ids in linear time ([@jkowall](https://github.com/jkowall) in [#9764](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9764))
* Fix(query): recover from panics in query grpc and mcp handlers ([@jkowall](https://github.com/jkowall) in [#9766](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9766))
* Feat(query): forward captured identity headers onto the acp agent handshake ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#10007](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/10007))
* Fix(mcp): guard trace walks against duplicate span ids ([@jkowall](https://github.com/jkowall) in [#9763](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9763))
* Fix(query): check filter nesting depth before decoding api_v3 parameters ([@jkowall](https://github.com/jkowall) in [#10006](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/10006))
* Feat(query): support prettyprint on the v3 http api ([@sksingh2005](https://github.com/sksingh2005) in [#9990](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9990))
* Fix(jaegermcp): expose total_span_count in get_trace_topology ([@alliasgher](https://github.com/alliasgher) in [#8530](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/8530))
* Feat(storage): honor anchors and case folding in regex filter patterns ([@ysh-bot](https://github.com/ysh-bot) in [#9923](https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/pull/9923))

## [4.0.0-rc.2](https://github.com/grafana/loki/compare/v4.0.0-rc.1...v4.0.0-rc.2) (2026-11-04)

### Reverts

* **loki:** Disable Multipath TCP on listeners by default ([#26237](https://github.com/grafana/loki/issues/26237)) ([7637697](https://github.com/grafana/loki/commit/763769726bd5e0ba6046dc6a4ba9af5509febbb2))


## [4.0.0-rc.1](https://github.com/grafana/loki/compare/v3.7.9...v4.0.0-rc.1) (2026-11-03)

### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* **compactor:** Remove deprecated `allow_deletes` configuration option ([#21808](https://github.com/grafana/loki/issues/21808))
* **engine:** Unplug the V2 query engine from the config and modules ([#25353](https://github.com/grafana/loki/issues/25353))

* **ingester:** Remove deprecated per-tenant setting `unordered_writes` ([#21835](https://github.com/grafana/loki/issues/21835))

* **logql:** Apply grouping to an errored sample's labels ([#24712](https://github.com/grafana/loki/issues/24712))
* **logql:** Remove support for experimental LogQL variants() queries ([#23823](https://github.com/grafana/loki/issues/23823))
* **loki:** Upgrade Go module to github.com/grafana/loki/v4 ([#25972](https://github.com/grafana/loki/issues/25972))
* **loki:** Remove deprecated `per_tenant_override_config` and `per_tenant_override_period` ([#22856](https://github.com/grafana/loki/issues/22856))

* **loki:** Rename metric `loki_log_flushes` ([#21765](https://github.com/grafana/loki/issues/21765))
* **loki:** Remove deprecated `loki_log_messages_total` metric ([#21764](https://github.com/grafana/loki/issues/21764))
* **operator:** Stop reconciliation of deprecated BoltDB schemas ([#24990](https://github.com/grafana/loki/issues/24990))

* **querytee:** Configure a primary and a secondary backend ([#25552](https://github.com/grafana/loki/issues/25552))

* **querytee:** Remove the routing modes ([#25487](https://github.com/grafana/loki/issues/25487))
* **ruler:** Remove deprecated ruler_remote_write_* per-tenant limits ([#22941](https://github.com/grafana/loki/issues/22941))

* **ruler:** Always wipe the remote-write WAL on startup ([#22509](https://github.com/grafana/loki/issues/22509))
* **storage:** Rename remaining `loki_boltdb_shipper_*` metrics to `loki_tsdb_shipper_*` ([#25345](https://github.com/grafana/loki/issues/25345))
* **storage:** Remove `row_shards` from the schema configuration ([#23683](https://github.com/grafana/loki/issues/23683))
* **storage:** Remove the disable_broad_index_queries setting ([#23679](https://github.com/grafana/loki/issues/23679))
* **storage:** Remove unused `period_config` settings that are no longer used by TSDB index ([#23665](https://github.com/grafana/loki/issues/23665))
* **storage:** Use Thanos storage clients by default ([#22676](https://github.com/grafana/loki/issues/22676))
* **storage:** Remove index read cache and index cache validity settings ([#22066](https://github.com/grafana/loki/issues/22066))

* **storage:** Remove deprecated Cassandra storage backend ([#21574](https://github.com/grafana/loki/issues/21574))
* **storage:** Remove support for BigTable/GCP storage backend ([#21502](https://github.com/grafana/loki/issues/21502))

items.title: Bridging Alloy and OpenTelemetry: the OTel engine is now in Public Preview
items.summary: Many Grafana Cloud customers love what Alloy offers them, but we're also seeing a growing base of users who feel the same way about the OpenTelemetry Collector. We want to make it easy for customers to make the decision that makes the most sense, regardless of their preference. When we introduced the OpenTelemetry engine for Grafana Alloy , we set out to give teams a way to run native OTLP pipelines without giving up the power and flexibility Alloy is known for. Since then we've kept building: ironing out service installation support, enabling Fleet Management , and folding in feedback from early users. Today, as of Alloy v1.21.0, we're happy to share that the OTel engine has moved into Public Preview , running right alongside the default engine you already know. In this post, we'll dig into when you'd reach for each engine, walk through some of the most interesting use cases we've seen so far, and give a preview of where both engines are headed next. - [FEATURE] API: Allow overriding PromQL Start Timestamp processing on a per-query basis using the `X-Prometheus-Use-Start-Timestamps` HTTP header. #19066

- [FEATURE] PromQL: Add experimental `integral()` function for computing integral-over-time of range vectors behind the `--enable-feature=promql-experimental-functions` flag. #14440

- [FEATURE] Promtool: print test filename during promtool tests #18271
- [FEATURE] PromQL: Allow unquoted Unicode letters and dots behind a feature flag #20162
- [ENHANCEMENT] Search API: Warn when participating remote-read storage does not support search. #19992
- [ENHANCEMENT] Remote Read: Add native histogram prometheus_remote_read_handler_gate_wait_duration_seconds to measure concurrency-gate wait duration, including requests canceled while waiting. #18355
- [ENHANCEMENT] Remote Write: Add experimental flag `convert_nhcb_to_classic` to convert NHCB to classic histograms for external systems that dont support NHCBs. #17205
- [ENHANCEMENT] promtool: Add `--allow-incompatible-block-duration` so users can specify any max-block-duration instead of being restricted to the default Prometheus block durations. #19363
- [PERF] Remote write: Cache repeated OTLP histogram metric names. #19717
- [PERF] OpenMetrics 2.0 parser: Reuse classic histogram and summary expansion buffers across scrapes. #19907
- [PERF] PromQL: Decode only histogram sum/count (not buckets) for timestamp(), start_timestamp() and absent(). #19738
- [PERF] PromQL: Only select the fixed window for subqueries with an `@` modifier. #19863
- [PERF] Remote write / TSDB: Deduplicate per-series metadata structs in memory with `unique.Handle`. #20040
- [PERF] Scrape: Avoid some copies of scrape response bodies. #19394
- [PERF] TSDB: Improve XOR2 compression and append performance by selecting value windows based on encoding cost. #19962
- [PERF] TSDB: Reduce memory used writing and reading checkpoint metadata records. #19712
- [PERF] Scrape: Convert classic histograms to NHCB directly in the OpenMetrics 2.0 parser without wrapping in `NHCBParser`. #19880
- [PERF] Scrape: Reduce OpenMetrics 2.0 parser allocations and CPU overhead by lazily constructing composite series and exemplar labels. #19895
- [BUGFIX] Remote read: Abort failed streaming responses without writing duplicate headers or appending plain-text errors to the protobuf stream #19749
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix loss of out-of-order samples when a WAL checkpoint drops a series record that the out-of-order write-behind log still needs #19737
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix queries that seek within a head chunk returning samples committed after the query started #19854
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Preserve mapped chunks when WAL replay merges multiple references for the same series, preventing missing out-of-order samples and duplicate in-order chunks after restart #19805
- [BUGFIX] Fix auto-reload logic to reload after reverting a failed configuration change #19838
- [BUGFIX] API: Do not match metric family metadata for doubled _total and _info suffixes in experimental search API. #19910
- [BUGFIX] API: Reject `timeout` and `lookback_delta` values that overflow int64 instead of turning them into a negative duration #19658
- [BUGFIX] API: Resolve metric family metadata for suffixed metric names in search results, in experimental search API. #19824
- [BUGFIX] AWS SD: Describe each ElastiCache cluster once instead of twice for clusters that are not replication group members. #19434
- [BUGFIX] Build: Allow installing promtool with version-suffixed go install commands #19754
- [BUGFIX] Discovery: Fix a panic in Azure service discovery when a VM tag has a null value. #19755
- [BUGFIX] Federation: fix corruption of float native histograms. #19679
- [BUGFIX] Fix ts_of_last_over_time for samples before the Unix epoch. #19828
- [BUGFIX] Histograms: Fix ConvertNHCBToClassic inflating classic bucket counts for integer native histograms whose spans have gaps. #19659
- [BUGFIX] Logging: Preserve rule and TSDB block values in JSON logs. #19572
- [BUGFIX] OTLP receiver: Drop exemplars with timestamps more than 10 minutes in the future instead of storing them and blocking subsequent exemplars for that series. #19812
- [BUGFIX] OTLP: Count only out-of-order exemplars in `prometheus_api_otlp_out_of_order_exemplars_total`, not every rejected exemplar. #20030
- [BUGFIX] OTLP: Do not drop exemplars that have a `trace_id` or `span_id` filtered attribute in addition to a trace or span ID. The trace context now takes precedence over the colliding attribute, as required by the OpenTelemetry specification. #20004
- [BUGFIX] OTLP: Do not emit `le="+Inf"` twice when a histogram's explicit bounds end at `+Inf`, and warn about the bound. #19425
- [BUGFIX] OTLP: Stop dropping exemplars that arrive out of timestamp order within a data point. #20029
- [BUGFIX] OpenMetrics 2.0: Attach histogram exemplars to matching classic `_bucket` series and preserve them when scraping both native and classic histograms. #20020
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Avoid intermediate overflow in `rad()` and `deg()` conversions. #19901
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Consistently ignore and drop `__type__` and `__unit__` labels in `without` aggregations, `absent()`, `info()`, and binary operator fill matching. #19986
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Do not panic when printing the partial AST returned alongside a parse error. #19797
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Drop __type__ and __unit__ in binary operations so they are transparent to users, similar to how __name__ is handled. #18680
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix `==`, `!=`, `changes()` and `count_values` on native histograms giving wrong results inside `histogram_count()`, `histogram_sum()` and `histogram_avg()`. #20024
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix histogram_fraction returning wrong results for native histograms with custom buckets when a bucket boundary is exactly 0. #19657
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix histogram_quantile and histogram_quantiles interpolating within the wrong bucket for native histograms whose sum is NaN. #19973
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix lexing of subqueries whose range is a duration keyword expression, e.g. `foo[range():1s]`. #19729
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix warning and error locations for duration expressions `min_of` and `max_of`. #19742
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Ignore NaN classic histogram bucket boundaries in `histogram_quantile`, `histogram_quantiles` and `histogram_fraction` and return correct value instead of NaN if there are normal buckets. #20057
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Preserve infinite values at exact quantile ranks. #19899
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Preserve original operand sides for experimental fill modifiers with group_right matching. #19939
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Preserve subquery step expressions when printing queries after preprocessing. #19743
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Range vector functions no longer raise a spurious "vector cannot contain metrics with the same labelset" error when series have different metric names but the same remaining labels, as long as their timestamps do not overlap within the evaluated range window #18631
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: do not count subquery materialized samples in total samples statistics #19873
- [BUGFIX] Remote write: Prevent future-dated exemplars from scaling shards down to the minimum. #19866
- [BUGFIX] Agent: Prevent future sent timestamps from advancing WAL truncation beyond the minimum retention window. #19866
- [BUGFIX] Rules: Restore firing alerts with for durations shorter than --rules.alert.for-grace-period after a restart. #19882
- [BUGFIX] Scrape: fix failing scrape when float histogram is emitted over protobuf with count, zero count and buckets all zero, for example a result of recording `rate(x[1m])` over constant histogram. #19682
- [BUGFIX] Search API: Return the lexically smallest label values when `limit` is set on `/api/v1/search/label_values`, instead of an arbitrary subset #19694
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix WAL watcher permanently skipping checkpoint series garbage collection when lagging behind head truncation. #20041
- [BUGFIX] Search API: Avoid panics when the requested time range has no participating storage. #19992
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix a race in selected-series and stale-series compaction where a sample committed after the block was written but before the series was evicted from the head could be silently lost. The fix no longer depends on isolation being enabled. #19666
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix a rare case where a sample could be lost during selected-series or stale-series compaction if an unrelated write to the same series ran cleanup that erased the evidence needed to protect it. #19672
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix spurious "unknown series references" warnings during WAL replay after a restart, when the only blocks on disk were produced by selected-series or stale-series compaction. #19734
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Increment `prometheus_tsdb_wal_corruptions_total` when WAL corruption is detected during checkpoint creation, so the metric reflects corruption found at compaction time rather than only after a restart-triggered repair. #19858
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Preserve series identities needed to recover exemplars after compaction and restart. #19940
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Reject native histograms whose span offsets overflow the int32 bucket index instead of storing them with corrupted buckets. #20034
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: fix no passing metadata-wal-records to TSDB from main feature flag. #19678
- [BUGFIX] Templates: Preserve IPv6 addresses with dotted zone identifiers in `stripDomain`. #19908
- [BUGFIX] UI: Don't automatically open an autocomplete dropdown after closing a function call body or aggregation operator with a closing parenthesis. #19825
- [BUGFIX] Web: Fix HTTP/2 negotiation silently falling back to HTTP/1.1 under Go 1.27+ when TLS is enabled with `http2: true`. The server now correctly advertises `h2` via ALPN and multiplexes concurrent requests over a single connection. #19848
- [BUGFIX] mixin: Fix double-counting of failed samples in the `PrometheusRemoteStorageFailures` alert denominator. #19877
- [BUGFIX] promtool: Honor `--enable-feature` when evaluating rules in `test rules`. #20046
- [BUGFIX] Scrape: Ensure UTF-8 works with the experimental OpenMetrics 2.0 #19902
- [BUGFIX] Scrape: Reject sum-only classic histograms during NHCB conversion #19315

items.title: Trace linkage: connect the dots between your app traces and database queries
items.summary: When an application request slows down, a trace can show a database call. Finding the database query behind it can be tedious, requiring you to switch between traces and database telemetry, as well as match timestamps or query text by hand. In Grafana Cloud, the Database Observability app already provides a window into all of your database telemetry, including query samples, performance history, and explain plan. But what if you could jump from that database call in the trace straight to its query details? OpenTelemetry database semantic conventions stabilized last year, giving us all a dependable shared language for describing database operations. That foundation has opened the door for what we call trace linkage , now Generally Available in Database Observability! What is trace linkage? With trace linkage, we try to provide a connection between OpenTelemetry-instrumented applications and database telemetry collected with Alloy . In other words, when you give us these previously-disjoint puzzle pieces, we’ll do our best to provide you as much supporting information between these two

items.summary: Summary of Changes
items.release_notes:
Summary of Changes
------------------

**Major Changes:**
* bgp: support interface-based BGP unnumbered peering through autoDiscovery.mode: Unnumbered, discovering the peer's IPv6 link-local address on a configured interface and sending Router Advertisements for peer discovery. (cilium/cilium#47394, @ecbaldwin)
* Enable BPF masquerading by default (cilium/cilium#49411, @pchaigno)
* gateway-api: Add frontend client certificate validation (mTLS) support. (cilium/cilium#48587, @arybolovlev)
* gateway-api: add initial support for listener TLS version options. (cilium/cilium#49063, @arybolovlev)
* network-driver: support Multi Pool Resource IPAM in the agent (cilium/cilium#49222, @andreaterzolo)

**Minor Changes:**
* [network-driver] Add multi-pool Resource IPAM support in the operator (cilium/cilium#48764, @pippolo84)
* Add Gateway API Inference Extension support (cilium/cilium#48969, @xtineskim)
* Add ingressController.service.insecurePortEnabled and ingressController.service.securePortEnabled to control whether the shared Cilium Ingress Service exposes port 80 and port 443. (cilium/cilium#48870, @bitflicker64)
* Add runtime reconciliation and garbage collection for endpoint routing rules in ENI, Azure, and AlibabaCloud IPv4 IPAM modes. (cilium/cilium#48383, @pippolo84)
* alibabacloud: support IMDSv2 (token-based) instance metadata access (cilium/cilium#49182, @4n4nd)
* alibabacloud: support RRSA (RAM Roles for Service Accounts) credentials in the IPAM allocator, alongside static AccessKeys and ECS instance RAM roles (cilium/cilium#49093, @4n4nd)
* cilium-cli: fall back to WebSocket when a proxy rejects the SPDY upgrade (cilium/cilium#49229, @epb-644)
* datapath: Prioritize preferred IPv6 addresses over deprecated ones during node-address selection. (cilium/cilium#49451, @kyyril)
* datapath: turn `DEBUG_TAGGED` into runtime config (cilium/cilium#49393, @ekoops)
* Deprecate XDP prefilter (cilium/cilium#49589, @joestringer)
* docs: document Cilium installation on ACK BYOCNI (cilium/cilium#49258, @l1b0k)
* Don't select IPv4/IPv6 addresses flagged deprecated when determining the node address (cilium/cilium#47878, @arcusbuilds)
* egressgw: Support egress IPs that the gateway node owns through a local route instead of an interface address, such as the IPs of GCE forwarding rules. (cilium/cilium#49400, @sudeephb)
* feat/ces: cilium-operator now patches CES before deleting it whenever CES has at least `--ces-empty-before-delete-threshold` number of endpoints. (cilium/cilium#49215, @kamilWyszynski1)
* gateway-api: BackendTLSPolicy is now supported for GRPCRoutes. (cilium/cilium#49130, @adilalperenciftci)
* gateway-api: Fix Gateway API controllers failing to start in clusters with many namespaces when a Gateway listener uses an `allowedRoutes` namespace selector (cilium/cilium#49238, @Nevon)
* helm: Add attachMetadata option to ServiceMonitors (cilium/cilium#49259, @kirill-iakovlev)
* helm: Add more extension hooks for Hubble Relay (cilium/cilium#49097, @devodev)
* Hubble flows now include Kubernetes workload information for endpoints on remote nodes. (cilium/cilium#48563, @devodev)
* hubble: Fix typo in --port-forward flag description (cilium/cilium#49126, @neronkang)
* ipam: Remove `--bypass-ip-availability-upon-restore` flag (cilium/cilium#49135, @HadrienPatte)
* k8s: Use omitzero for struct fields of CiliumNode and CiliumEndpoint (cilium/cilium#49220, @HadrienPatte)
* Make internal label handling more memory-efficient (cilium/cilium#49692, @1stDimension)
* metrics: Added cilium_agent_memory_bytes, an estimate of agent memory usage broken down by component, so that BPF memlock is accounted for alongside the Go heap. (cilium/cilium#48227, @mvisonneau)
* Migrate AlibabaCloud IPAM to the Multi-pool allocator (cilium/cilium#49303, @TonyNee)
* Move cloud-IPAM endpoint route and policy-rule management from CNI to the Cilium agent. (cilium/cilium#48384, @pippolo84)
* nat: Don't masquerade node InternalIP addresses (cilium/cilium#49344, @pchaigno)
* network driver: add RX queue manager (cilium/cilium#49520, @aarcamp)
* network driver: allow setting interface sysctl for allocated devices (cilium/cilium#48711, @bersoare)
* network driver: prepare NICs for RX queue leasing (cilium/cilium#49651, @aarcamp)
* network driver: support DRA consumable capacity (cilium/cilium#48863, @aarcamp)
* operator/ipam: A node's attached IPs change in cloud IPAM modes now reconciles only that node instead of every node in the cluster. This decreases the volume of operator CiliumNode writes and pool maintenance passes on large clusters. (cilium/cilium#49687, @HadrienPatte)
* pkg/aws: Secondary ENIs get an IPv6 configured to their netlink devices to make sure nodeports work when using kube-proxy. (cilium/cilium#48652, @41ks)
* proxy: Bump envoy version to 1.40.x (cilium/cilium#49491, @sayboras)
* Restore L2 announcements for Gateway API and Ingress LoadBalancer Services that use externalTrafficPolicy: Local. (cilium/cilium#49003, @lavish-gambhir)
* The deprecated option `--tofqdns-pre-cache` has been removed. (cilium/cilium#49124, @HadrienPatte)

**Bugfixes:**
* Allow wildcard CIDR selectors to match nodes when --policy-cidr-match-mode=nodes is configured (cilium/cilium#47828, @TheBeeZee)
* azure: Fixed an issue where an interface with an empty MAC field would be reported back the the cilium agent causing it to crash on startup when trying to configure the routes. (cilium/cilium#48648, @41ks)
* bpf: nat: fix outer ICMP checksum for ICMP/SCTP NAT error packets (cilium/cilium#48819, @fds7280)
* cilium-dbg: Print port numbers correctly for map cilium_lb*_reverse_sk (cilium/cilium#47134, @jayl1e)
* CiliumEnvoyConfig now only redirects Services in its own namespace, as documented; service references in CiliumClusterwideEnvoyConfig without a namespace default to "default" again. (cilium/cilium#49076, @maxskokov)
* datapath/config: use buffered writer for `#include "lib/utils.h"` (cilium/cilium#49342, @ekoops)
* datapath: Fix NAT46x64 gateway prefix conversion panic (cilium/cilium#49177, @HadrienPatte)
* endpoint: use final regeneration error to resolve rollback state (cilium/cilium#49471, @jrajahalme)
* envoy: drain proxy completions on cancellation and early errors (cilium/cilium#49489, @jrajahalme)
* Extend L7 redirect ID defintion with L7 parser type, so that http and tls rules on same endpoint/port use separate proxy listeners. (cilium/cilium#49549, @nezdolik)
* feat/ces: omitzero tag for CoreCiliumEndpoint (cilium/cilium#49186, @kamilWyszynski1)
* Fix a leak of load balancer BPF map entries for NodePort services that have different external and internal traffic policies. (cilium/cilium#49373, @vt0r)
* Fix a race in AWS, Alibaba Cloud, and Azure IPAM where partial resyncs could overwrite newer cache updates, making released IPs appear available again. (cilium/cilium#49620, @pippolo84)
* Fix accidental reintroduction of the Envoy policy for a removed endpoint, which would then cause persistent Envoy NACK upon endpoint IP reuse. (cilium/cilium#49652, @jrajahalme)
* Fix agent bootstrap to order endpoint regeneration after DNS proxy initialization to prevent proxy port race. (cilium/cilium#49540, @jrajahalme)
* Fix an issue where terminating backends were evicted from BPF maps when trafficDistribution was enabled. (cilium/cilium#48349, @taesung320)
* Fix connections to a pod timing out when the client reuses the source port of a closed NodePort or HostPort connection to that pod. (cilium/cilium#47641, @aanm)
* Fix egress policy rules that combine `toServices` with `toPorts` allowing traffic to any destination on those ports when the referenced Service doesn't exist or is selector-less with no backends. (cilium/cilium#49430, @christarazi)
* Fix etcd connectivity diagnostics to honor the configured timeout when reading the heartbeat key on high-latency connections. (cilium/cilium#49562, @grzesrap)
* Fix HTTP URL query not being redacted in Hubble flows when the Envoy access log URL fails to parse. (cilium/cilium#49427, @sage-mode-hunter)
* Fix Hubble dynamic metrics retaining deleted-pod series by applying endpoint-deletion cleanup to the active dynamic metric handlers. (cilium/cilium#49712, @alexcastilio)
* Fix invalid L4 checksum on IPv6 ClusterIP reverse NAT for CHECKSUM_PARTIAL packets on kernels < 6.12, affecting the case when packets are bridged/tunneled from the client pod to a remote host (cilium/cilium#49204, @liuyuan10)
* Fix ip6tables chain rename errors being silently ignored during iptables rule reconciliation. (cilium/cilium#49024, @maxskokov)
* Fix multi-pool IPAM spreading pod IPs across multiple CIDRs instead of filling the oldest CIDRs first. This kept unused IPs from being released, so nodes held more CIDRs than they needed. (cilium/cilium#49418, @41ks)
* Fix nodes sending out ARP probes for their own IPs when L2 neighbor discovery is enabled. (cilium/cilium#49404, @rtapadar)
* Fix regression in Cilium 1.20.3 where the Gateway API implementation would incorrectly handle BackendTLSPolicy configurations, leading to high Cilium CPU usage and inability to forward traffic. (cilium/cilium#49525, @youngnick)
* Fix restored endpoints getting only policy rules that select all endpoints. (cilium/cilium#49091, @jaredledvina)
* Fix strict egress encryption allowing unencrypted traffic when --encryption-strict-egress-cidr contains host bits. (cilium/cilium#49446, @fds7280)
* Fix the bandwidth manager dropping all egress traffic of a rate-limited pod for up to tens of seconds after a single packet carried a departure time beyond the drop horizon. (cilium/cilium#49653, @IraSkyx)
* Fix the operator allocating IPv4 addresses and IPv4-bearing ENIs to IPv6-only nodes in ENI IPAM mode. (cilium/cilium#49107, @41ks)
* Fix the operator releasing ENI multi-pool IPs below min-allocate, causing nodes to immediately allocate the IPs again. (cilium/cilium#49125, @jaredledvina)
* Fix two services ending up with the same service ID after an agent restart, and repair nodes where this already happened. (cilium/cilium#49224, @tahsinrahman)
* fix: Overlay revSNAT entry missed extended masquerade port range fallback (cilium/cilium#48229, @weizhoublue)
* Fixed a goroutine leak that could cause Cilium agents to accumulate thousands of goroutines under sustained CiliumNode churn, increasing CPU usage and contributing to latency or packet drops. (cilium/cilium#46257, @evevseev)
* Fixed an issue where DNS egress policy could deny requests after a destination’s security identity changed. DNS proxy rules now refresh alongside incremental policy updates. (cilium/cilium#49699, @tklauser)

items.title: OpenTelemetry eBPF Instrumentation reaches v1.0.0
items.summary: We’re excited to announce v1.0.0 of OpenTelemetry eBPF Instrumentation—OBI! OBI brings OpenTelemetry observability to running Linux applications without requiring changes to their source code. It uses eBPF, together with runtime-specific instrumentation, to capture application metrics and traces across services, languages, and frameworks. You can start with request rates, errors, latency, and service dependencies, then build deeper visibility as your needs grow. This release fulfills the flagship goal we set for 2026 : establishing a stable foundation for OBI. It represents a year of expanding instrumentation coverage, improving correctness, strengthening release tooling, and building the compatibility and telemetry migration practices that users need to operate OBI over time.

items.title: Only include resource detectors you need by building your own Collector
items.summary: There are many reasons for building your own OpenTelemetry Collector distribution. The existing distributions are designed to be broadly useful, which means they include many more components than what an individual deployment uses. Building your own gives you the ability to select only the components you care about, add your own custom components, and control exactly what ends up in the binary you run in production. One of the reasons I prefer to build my own distribution is to limit the size of the binary I have to ship around and to ensure that the least amount of dependencies are included. Fewer dependencies means a smaller binary, a smaller attack surface, and fewer third-party modules to track when a vulnerability is disclosed. The OpenTelemetry Collector Builder (ocb) makes this possible: you write a manifest file in YAML to select the components you care about, and ocb compiles them into the resulting binary.

items.title: Faster, smaller checkpoints: the File Log receiver now uses protobuf
items.summary: If you run the File Log receiver with a storage extension, the Collector writes a checkpoint every time it polls your log files. That checkpoint is how the receiver remembers where it stopped reading, so a restart does not lose or duplicate logs. For years that checkpoint format was JSON. Starting with OpenTelemetry Collector Contrib v0.164.0, checkpoints are always written as protobuf. On our benchmarks, saving a checkpoint is almost 5 times faster, loading one is more than 5 times faster, and the checkpoint itself is about 35% smaller.

(#20080, @shilohlee98)
- [CHANGE] Remote write receiver: Count Remote Write 2.x samples and histograms ingested without metadata in `prometheus_api_remote_write_without_metadata_appended_samples_total` even when `metadata-wal-records` is disabled. (#19812, @bwplotka)
- [CHANGE] TSDB: Reject exemplars whose label names are not unique, instead of storing them and serving a duplicate JSON key from `/api/v1/query_exemplars`. (#19896, @Ramya-9353)
- [FEATURE] API: Allow overriding PromQL Start Timestamp processing on a per-query basis using the `X-Prometheus-Use-Start-Timestamps` HTTP header. (#19066, @69iqqq)
- [FEATURE] Agent: Support metadata-wal-records in Prometheus Agent mode. (#19684, @bwplotka)
- [FEATURE] PromQL: Add experimental `integral()` function for computing integral-over-time of range vectors behind the `--enable-feature=promql-experimental-functions` flag. (#14440, @jjo)
- [FEATURE] PromQL: Add experimental query cost estimation, actual cost reporting, and configurable execution limits, enabled with `--enable-feature=query-cost`. (#20028, @roidelapluie)
- [FEATURE] PromQL: Smoothed and Anchored vector selectors are now stable and always-on. (#19697, @roidelapluie)
- [FEATURE] PromQL: Use start timestamps to detect counter resets when float timeseries are queried using extended range selector modifiers (`anchored`, `smoothed`). This feature is hidden behind `use-start-timestamps` feature flag. (#18966, @vpranckaitis)
- [FEATURE] Promtool: print test filename during promtool tests (#18271, @dnwe)
- [FEATURE] PromQL: Allow unquoted Unicode letters and dots behind a feature flag (#20162, @roidelapluie)
- [ENHANCEMENT] Search API: Warn when participating remote-read storage does not support search. (#19992, @aknuds1)
- [ENHANCEMENT] Remote Read: Add native histogram prometheus_remote_read_handler_gate_wait_duration_seconds to measure concurrency-gate wait duration, including requests canceled while waiting. (#18355, @ogulcanaydogan)
- [ENHANCEMENT] Remote Write: Add experimental flag `convert_nhcb_to_classic` to convert NHCB to classic histograms for external systems that dont support NHCBs. (#17205, @Naman-B-Parlecha)
- [ENHANCEMENT] promtool: Add `--allow-incompatible-block-duration` so users can specify any max-block-duration instead of being restricted to the default Prometheus block durations. (#19363, @sarthaksarthak9)
- [PERF] Remote write: Cache repeated OTLP histogram metric names. (#19717, @perfloop-agent)
- [PERF] OpenMetrics 2.0 parser: Reuse classic histogram and summary expansion buffers across scrapes. (#19907, @bwplotka)
- [PERF] PromQL: Decode only histogram sum/count (not buckets) for timestamp(), start_timestamp() and absent(). (#19738, @linasm)
- [PERF] PromQL: Only select the fixed window for subqueries with an `@` modifier. (#19863, @roidelapluie)
- [PERF] Remote write / TSDB: Deduplicate per-series metadata structs in memory with `unique.Handle`. (#20040, @bwplotka)
- [PERF] Scrape: Avoid some copies of scrape response bodies. (#19394, @shubhgupta2104)
- [PERF] TSDB: Improve XOR2 compression and append performance by selecting value windows based on encoding cost. (#19962, @roidelapluie)
- [PERF] TSDB: Reduce memory used writing and reading checkpoint metadata records. (#19712, @kgeckhart)
- [PERF] Scrape: Convert classic histograms to NHCB directly in the OpenMetrics 2.0 parser without wrapping in `NHCBParser`. (#19880, @bwplotka)
- [PERF] Scrape: Reduce OpenMetrics 2.0 parser allocations and CPU overhead by lazily constructing composite series and exemplar labels. (#19895, @bwplotka)
- [BUGFIX] Remote read: Abort failed streaming responses without writing duplicate headers or appending plain-text errors to the protobuf stream (#19749, @aknuds1)
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix loss of out-of-order samples when a WAL checkpoint drops a series record that the out-of-order write-behind log still needs (#19737, @replay)
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix queries that seek within a head chunk returning samples committed after the query started (#19854, @aknuds1)
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Preserve mapped chunks when WAL replay merges multiple references for the same series, preventing missing out-of-order samples and duplicate in-order chunks after restart (#19805, @dmatth1)
- [BUGFIX] Fix auto-reload logic to reload after reverting a failed configuration change (#19838, @eholzbach)
- [BUGFIX] API: Do not match metric family metadata for doubled _total and _info suffixes in experimental search API. (#19910, @tcp13equals2)
- [BUGFIX] API: Reject `timeout` and `lookback_delta` values that overflow int64 instead of turning them into a negative duration (#19658, @youdie006)
- [BUGFIX] API: Resolve metric family metadata for suffixed metric names in search results, in experimental search API. (#19824, @roidelapluie)
- [BUGFIX] AWS SD: Describe each ElastiCache cluster once instead of twice for clusters that are not replication group members. (#19434, @ekalinin)
- [BUGFIX] Build: Allow installing promtool with version-suffixed go install commands (#19754, @aknuds1)
- [BUGFIX] Discovery: Fix a panic in Azure service discovery when a VM tag has a null value. (#19755, @shoemoney)
- [BUGFIX] Federation: fix corruption of float native histograms. (#19679, @MichaHoffmann)
- [BUGFIX] Fix ts_of_last_over_time for samples before the Unix epoch. (#19828, @fallintoplace)
- [BUGFIX] Histograms: Fix ConvertNHCBToClassic inflating classic bucket counts for integer native histograms whose spans have gaps. (#19659, @youdie006)
- [BUGFIX] Logging: Preserve rule and TSDB block values in JSON logs. (#19572, @shilohlee98)
- [BUGFIX] OTLP receiver: Drop exemplars with timestamps more than 10 minutes in the future instead of storing them and blocking subsequent exemplars for that series. (#19812, @bwplotka)
- [BUGFIX] OTLP: Count only out-of-order exemplars in `prometheus_api_otlp_out_of_order_exemplars_total`, not every rejected exemplar. (#20030, @aknuds1)
- [BUGFIX] OTLP: Do not drop exemplars that have a `trace_id` or `span_id` filtered attribute in addition to a trace or span ID. The trace context now takes precedence over the colliding attribute, as required by the OpenTelemetry specification. (#20004, @krajorama)
- [BUGFIX] OTLP: Do not emit `le="+Inf"` twice when a histogram's explicit bounds end at `+Inf`, and warn about the bound. (#19425, @serhiy-bzhezytskyy)
- [BUGFIX] OTLP: Stop dropping exemplars that arrive out of timestamp order within a data point. (#20029, @aknuds1)
- [BUGFIX] OpenMetrics 2.0: Attach histogram exemplars to matching classic `_bucket` series and preserve them when scraping both native and classic histograms. (#20020, @dashpole)
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Avoid intermediate overflow in `rad()` and `deg()` conversions. (#19901, @fallintoplace)
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Consistently ignore and drop `__type__` and `__unit__` labels in `without` aggregations, `absent()`, `info()`, and binary operator fill matching. (#19986, @dashpole)
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Do not panic when printing the partial AST returned alongside a parse error. (#19797, @zenador)
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Drop __type__ and __unit__ in binary operations so they are transparent to users, similar to how __name__ is handled. (#18680, @iam-prane-eth)
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix `==`, `!=`, `changes()` and `count_values` on native histograms giving wrong results inside `histogram_count()`, `histogram_sum()` and `histogram_avg()`. (#20024, @linasm)
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix histogram_fraction returning wrong results for native histograms with custom buckets when a bucket boundary is exactly 0. (#19657, @youdie006)
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix histogram_quantile and histogram_quantiles interpolating within the wrong bucket for native histograms whose sum is NaN. (#19973, @bhabishnu)
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix lexing of subqueries whose range is a duration keyword expression, e.g. `foo[range():1s]`. (#19729, @roidelapluie)
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Fix warning and error locations for duration expressions `min_of` and `max_of`. (#19742, @roidelapluie)
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Ignore NaN classic histogram bucket boundaries in `histogram_quantile`, `histogram_quantiles` and `histogram_fraction` and return correct value instead of NaN if there are normal buckets. (#20057, @fallintoplace)
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Preserve infinite values at exact quantile ranks. (#19899, @fallintoplace)
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Preserve original operand sides for experimental fill modifiers with group_right matching. (#19939, @inanna-malick)
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Preserve subquery step expressions when printing queries after preprocessing. (#19743, @roidelapluie)
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: Range vector functions no longer raise a spurious "vector cannot contain metrics with the same labelset" error when series have different metric names but the same remaining labels, as long as their timestamps do not overlap within the evaluated range window (#18631, @kasharkzy)
- [BUGFIX] PromQL: do not count subquery materialized samples in total samples statistics (#19873, @roidelapluie)
- [BUGFIX] Remote write: Prevent future-dated exemplars from scaling shards down to the minimum. (#19866, @thampiotr)
- [BUGFIX] Agent: Prevent future sent timestamps from advancing WAL truncation beyond the minimum retention window. (#19866, @thampiotr)
- [BUGFIX] Rules: Restore firing alerts with for durations shorter than --rules.alert.for-grace-period after a restart. (#19882, @ajaykr0905)
- [BUGFIX] Scrape: fix failing scrape when float histogram is emitted over protobuf with count, zero count and buckets all zero, for example a result of recording `rate(x[1m])` over constant histogram. (#19682, @MichaHoffmann)
- [BUGFIX] Search API: Return the lexically smallest label values when `limit` is set on `/api/v1/search/label_values`, instead of an arbitrary subset (#19694, @tcp13equals2)
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix WAL watcher permanently skipping checkpoint series garbage collection when lagging behind head truncation. (#20041, @bwplotka)
- [BUGFIX] Search API: Avoid panics when the requested time range has no participating storage. (#19992, @aknuds1)
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix a race in selected-series and stale-series compaction where a sample committed after the block was written but before the series was evicted from the head could be silently lost. The fix no longer depends on isolation being enabled. (#19666, @duricanikolic)
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix a rare case where a sample could be lost during selected-series or stale-series compaction if an unrelated write to the same series ran cleanup that erased the evidence needed to protect it. (#19672, @duricanikolic)
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Fix spurious "unknown series references" warnings during WAL replay after a restart, when the only blocks on disk were produced by selected-series or stale-series compaction. (#19734, @duricanikolic)
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Increment `prometheus_tsdb_wal_corruptions_total` when WAL corruption is detected during checkpoint creation, so the metric reflects corruption found at compaction time rather than only after a restart-triggered repair. (#19858, @mstinsky)
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Preserve series identities needed to recover exemplars after compaction and restart. (#19940, @duricanikolic)
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: Reject native histograms whose span offsets overflow the int32 bucket index instead of storing them with corrupted buckets. (#20034, @Ramya-9353)
- [BUGFIX] TSDB: fix no passing metadata-wal-records to TSDB from main feature flag. (#19678, @krajorama)
- [BUGFIX] Templates: Preserve IPv6 addresses with dotted zone identifiers in `stripDomain`. (#19908, @ItsRoy69)
- [BUGFIX] UI: Don't automatically open an autocomplete dropdown after closing a function call body or aggregation operator with a closing parenthesis. (#19825, @juliusv)
- [BUGFIX] Web: Fix HTTP/2 negotiation silently falling back to HTTP/1.1 under Go 1.27+ when TLS is enabled with `http2: true`. The server now correctly advertises `h2` via ALPN and multiplexes concurrent requests over a single connection. (#19848, @dongjiang1989)
- [BUGFIX] mixin: Fix double-counting of failed samples in the `PrometheusRemoteStorageFailures` alert denominator. (#19877, @nikhilsaxena04)
- [BUGFIX] promtool: Honor `--enable-feature` when evaluating rules in `test rules`. (#20046, @dennisme)
- [BUGFIX] Scrape: Ensure UTF-8 works with the experimental OpenMetrics 2.0 (#19902, @bwplotka)
- [BUGFIX] Scrape: Reject sum-only classic histograms during NHCB conversion (#19315, @shubhgupta2104)

[CHANGE] Remote write receiver: Count Remote Write 2.x samples and histograms ingested without metadata in prometheus api remote write without metadata appended samples total even when metadata-wal-records is disabled. ( 19812, @bwplotka)
[CHANGE] TSDB: Reject exemplars whose label names are not unique, instead of storing them and serving a duplicate JSON key from /api/v1/query exemplars. ( 19896, @Ramya-9353)

items.title: Evaluate AI models for observability: o11y-bench joins Fireworks' Specialized Intelligence Index and reaches v1.1
items.summary: When evaluating AI models for observability, generating a plausible query or explanation isn't enough. Teams need to know whether an agent's conclusions are supported by telemetry, whether its changes to dashboards actually work, and whether it can deliver reliable results consistently. This is why we built o11y-bench , Grafana Labs' open benchmark for evaluating AI models on observability and SRE tasks. And today, we're excited to share two updates: o11y-bench is now part of the Specialized Intelligence Index from Fireworks , the AI training and inference platform, and we're releasing o11y-bench 1.1 , with updates that make grading more grounded, consistent, and reproducible. Bringing o11y-bench to the Specialized Intelligence Index The Specialized Intelligence Index brings together practitioner-built benchmarks for comparing how open, closed, and specialized AI models perform on domain-specific work, from healthcare and finance to cybersecurity and software engineering. It helps teams identify the best models for their workloads, understand where specialization adds value, and eval

items.title: OpenTelemetry Transformation Language reaches v1
items.summary: The OpenTelemetry Transformation Language (OTTL) is now v1. Starting with opentelemetry-collector-contrib v0.164.0, OTTL is stable for traces, metrics, and logs. The release of v1 means OTTL meets the Collector’s ‘stable’ stability criteria for testing, benchmarking, documentation, and telemetry. It also comes with a compatibility promise for all of 1.x. If you write OTTL statements, the syntax and the standard functions stay backward compatible. If you build your own components on top of OTTL, the Go API will also remain compatible.

items.title: Agent Observability FAQ: Understand the value of monitoring, evaluating, and improving your AI agents
items.summary: Agents have quickly become part of the tech landscape as organizations embrace AI across their businesses. But embracing agents also means embracing the monitoring best practices that have long been part of engineers' workflows: tracking performance, catching errors, and responding to incidents But it doesn't stop there. Agents also introduce new challenges. They can give different answers to the same question, be confidently wrong without throwing an error, and turn one request into a long chain of model and tool calls that’s hard to debug. A small prompt change can shift behavior as much as a code deploy. And because agents act on what they read, they open the door to new risks like prompt injection and leaked sensitive data. It's a lot to learn, but that's why we built Agent Observability , now generally available, as part of our growing set of AI-enabled features in Grafana Cloud. items.release_notes:
Check the [v0.164.0 contrib changelog](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/releases/tag/v0.164.0) and the [v0.164.0 core changelog](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/releases/tag/v0.164.0) for changelogs on specific components.


## Changelog

### 🚀 New components 🚀

- `otelcol-contrib`: Add the partitioning processor to the Contrib distribution (#1727)

### 💡 Enhancements 💡

- `otelcol`: Add the `file_log` receiver, `resource_detection` processor and `transform` processor to the core distribution. (#44130)
  These Contrib components are priorities for stabilization.
  See https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/issues/44130.
  

### 🧰 Bug fixes 🧰

- `all`: Build release binaries with Go 1.26.10 and require Alpine `ca-certificates` 20261020-r0 or later in container images. (#1722)
  Go 1.26.10 includes the `crypto/x509` security fixes released on 2026-10-19.
  The updated CA bundle removes the distrusted eMudhra emSign roots, including `emSign ECC Root CA - G3`.
