items.release_notes:
The OpenTelemetry Collector Contrib contains everything in the [opentelemetry-collector release](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/releases/tag/v0.164.0), be sure to check the release notes there as well.

## Unmaintained Components

These components are marked as [Unmaintained](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/blob/main/docs/component-stability.md#unmaintained) and will eventually be removed from our community distributions. If you depend on these components we need your help to support them.

- exporter/logicmonitor
- exporter/azuredataexplorer
- receiver/flinkmetrics

## End User Changelog

### 🛑 Breaking changes 🛑

- `connector/service_graph`: Remove stable connector.servicegraph.virtualNode gate (#52239)
- `exporter/prometheus`: Always preserve leading and consecutive underscores in label names. (#50429)
  Remove `-pkg.translator.prometheus.PermissiveLabelSanitization` from `--feature-gates`; disabling this gate now causes a startup error.
  
- `exporter/prometheus_remote_write`: Always preserve leading and consecutive underscores in label names. (#50429)
  Remove `-pkg.translator.prometheus.PermissiveLabelSanitization` from `--feature-gates`; disabling this gate now causes a startup error.
  
- `pkg/azurelogs`: Promote the `pkg.translator.azurelogs.EmitV1LogConventions` and `pkg.translator.azurelogs.DontEmitV0LogConventions` feature gates to beta. (#52096)
  `code.function.name` and `code.file.path` are now emitted instead of `code.function` and `code.filepath` by default.
  The gates no longer control the `event.name` resource attribute, which is always emitted.
  
- `pkg/coreinternal`: Promote internal.coreinternal.goldendataset.DontEmitV0HTTPConventions and internal.coreinternal.goldendataset.EmitV1HTTPConventions feature gates to Beta (#45293, #45089)
  Both feature gates should be promoted together as per RFC.
  goldendataset now generates spans with user_agent.original, network.protocol.name,
  network.protocol.version, client.address, and http.response.status_code (semconv v1.40.0)
  by default, and no longer generates the deprecated http.user_agent, http.flavor
  (semconv v1.19.0), http.client_ip, and http.status_code (semconv v1.25.0) attributes.
  The http.status_code migration is now wired to these gates so that round-trip translation
  stays consistent with pkg.translator.zipkin's HTTP semantic convention feature gates.
  
- `pkg/ottl`: Remove the stable `ottl.set.allowNil` feature gate. (#48714)
- `pkg/translator/pprof`: Return an error instead of panicking when profiling data contains invalid profile references. (#51908)
- `pkg/zipkin`: Promote "pkg.translator.zipkin.EmitV1HttpConventions", "pkg.translator.zipkin.DontEmitV0HttpConventions", "pkg.translator.zipkin.EmitV1ScopeConventions", and "pkg.translator.zipkin.DontEmitV0ScopeConventions" feature gates to Beta. (#50909)
  This changes the default behavior to emit the new semantic convention attributes instead of the old deprecated ones.
  The Zipkin translator will now use `http.response.status_code` (replacing `http.status_code`), `otel.scope.name`
  (replacing `otel.library.name`), and `otel.scope.version` (replacing `otel.library.version`) by default when emitting spans.
  
- `processor/drain`: Reject invalid configurations at startup, including negative `max_clusters` and empty attribute names. (#51677)
  Startup validation now rejects `max_node_children` <= 0, negative `max_clusters`, empty `template_attribute`,
  empty `wildcards_attribute` when `emit_wildcards` is set, and empty `parameter_key_prefix` when `masking_rules` are configured.
  
- `processor/filter`: remove stable processor.filter.defaultErrorModeIgnore gate (#52238)
- `receiver/file_log`: Promote the `filelog.protobufCheckpointEncoding` feature gate to stable. Checkpoints are always written as protobuf. (#43266, #52037)
  The feature gate can no longer be disabled and will be removed in v0.165.0.
  Existing JSON checkpoints are still read and are rewritten as protobuf on the next save.
  
- `receiver/kubelet_stats`: Remove the deprecated `aws.volume.id`, `fs.type`, `gce.pd.name`, `glusterfs.endpoints.name`, `glusterfs.path` and `partition` resource attributes. (#40477)
- `receiver/mongodb`: Change `mongodb.operation.latency.time` from a gauge to a monotonic cumulative sum (#51909)
  `opLatencies.*.latency` is a cumulative total, so the metric is now a monotonic sum like every
  other cumulative duration in the receiver. It is `enabled: false` and `stability: development`.
  
- `receiver/prometheus`: Remove the stable `receiver.prometheusreceiver.IgnoreScopeInfoMetric` feature gate. (#47312)

### 🚩 Deprecations 🚩

- `exporter/azuredataexplorer`: Mark component as unmaintained (#52055)
- `exporter/logicmonitor`: Mark component as unmaintained (#52152)
- `extension/google_client_auth`: Rename the googleclientauth extension to google_client_auth. The old name remains available as a deprecated alias. (#45339)
- `processor/probabilistic_sampler`: Add the `otelcol_processor_probabilistic_sampler_count_spans_processed` metric and deprecate `otelcol_processor_probabilistic_sampler_count_traces_sampled` in favor of it. (#50954)
  The deprecated metric remains available for compatibility.
- `processor/transform`: Deprecate the `flatten_data` option in favor of the new `flatten.log` option. (#51766)
  Replace `flatten_data: true` with `flatten: {log: true}`. `flatten_data` will be removed in a future release.
- `receiver/kafka`: Deprecate the built-in `jaeger_proto` and `jaeger_json` encodings in favour of `jaegerencodingextension`. (#39113)
- `receiver/kafka`: Deprecate `partition_processing.max_buffered_batches` in favour of `partition_processing.max_prefetch.batches`. It will be removed in v0.166.0. (#52253)
- `receiver/kafka`: Deprecate the built-in `json` logs encoding in favour of `jsonlogencodingextension`. (#39113)
- `receiver/riak`: Update the stability of the receiver from `beta` to `unmaintained` (#52051)

### 🚀 New components 🚀

- `extension/redis_fleet_tracker`: Add the redis_fleet_tracker extension, which reports a collector fleet's live member count so adaptive_tail_sampling can treat goal_throughput as a fleet-wide budget. (#50577)
- `processor/verify`: Add `verifyprocessor`, a new processor that verifies RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical integrity attributes (`audit.integrity.value`) on log records using HMAC and/or certificate public keys. Designed as the verification counterpart to `signingprocessor` for the OpenTelemetry Audit Logging signal. (#51383)
  This initial PR donates the component skeleton (config, factory, README). Concrete verification logic follows in a subsequent PR.
  
- `receiver/gnmi`: Introduce the gNMI receiver (#50848)
- `receiver/nats`: Add the NATS receiver to receive traces, metrics, and logs from a NATS server (skeleton; in development). (#50735)

### 💡 Enhancements 💡

- `cmd/opampsupervisor`: Add an `agent::stop_grace_period` config option to control how long the Supervisor waits for the Collector to exit after a graceful shutdown signal before forcibly killing it. (#50000)
  Defaults to 10s when unset.
- `exporter/awscloudwatchlogs`: resolve {ClusterName} placeholder via k8s.cluster.name attribute (#51601)
- `exporter/awss3`: Add `access_key` and `secret_key` options to configure static AWS credentials (#52140)
- `exporter/awsxray`: Add feature gates to migrate semantic conventions from v1.12.0 to v1.40.0 (#46537)
  Four new alpha feature gates control the migration:
  - `exporter.awsxray.EmitV1HTTPNetworkConventions`: reads HTTP/network span attributes using semconv v1.40.0 keys (e.g. http.request.method, server.address, server.port, client.address).
  - `exporter.awsxray.DontEmitV0HTTPNetworkConventions`: stops reading deprecated v1.12.0 HTTP/network attribute keys. Requires EmitV1HTTPNetworkConventions to also be enabled.
  - `exporter.awsxray.EmitV1DBConventions`: reads database span attributes using semconv v1.40.0 keys (db.namespace, db.system.name, db.query.text, user.name).
  - `exporter.awsxray.DontEmitV0DBConventions`: stops reading deprecated v1.12.0 database attribute keys. Requires EmitV1DBConventions to also be enabled.
  All gates default to disabled, preserving existing behavior. Enable the EmitV1 gate first for dual-read, then enable the DontEmitV0 gate once upstream instrumentation has migrated.
  
- `exporter/clickhouse`: Added a Bloom Filter data skipping index (idx_event_name) to the EventName column with a 0.01 false positive rate and granularity 1. (#49310)
- `exporter/elasticsearch`: Additionally retry context deadlines that expire before the connection is ready, including DNS, TCP handshake, and TLS handshake timeouts. (#52102)
  A context deadline after the connection is ready, including while the request is being written or while waiting for the response, is still not retried.
  
- `exporter/elasticsearch`: Add opt-in `telemetry::include_destination_index` to add the destination index as an attribute to the `otelcol.elasticsearch.docs.processed` metric (#52108)
- `exporter/elasticsearch`: Convert explicit bounds OTLP histograms to exponential histograms (#52113)
  In OTel mapping mode, explicit-bounds histograms are stored as the native `exponential_histogram` field when
  connected to Elasticsearch 9.4.0 or later; set `version_detection.enabled: false` to keep T-Digest histograms.
  
- `extension/json_log_encoding`: Set the observed timestamp of unmarshaled log records to the time the payload was decoded. (#39113)
- `extension/opamp`: Report component status attributes in OpAMP health messages. (#50330)
- `extension/opamp`: Add `reports_heartbeat` capability, enabled by default, to allow the OpAMP server to configure the agent's heartbeat interval (#51427)
- `extension/redis_storage`: Add `IncrementBy` and `BatchIncrementBy` for atomic integer counters shared across Collector instances. (#51567)
- `pkg/kafka/configkafka`: Add `dial_timeout` configuration option to control the timeout for establishing connections to Kafka brokers. (#51910)
- `pkg/ottl`: Promote traces, metrics, and logs signals from beta to stable. (#51068, #47305)
- `processor/adaptive_tail_sampling`: Add a metric to track multiple root span condition matches (#51458)
  Adds the otelcol_processor_adaptive_tail_sampling_root_span_condition_multiple_matches
  histogram, which records the number of spans matching the root span condition
  for traces where the condition matches more than once.
  
- `processor/cardinality_guardian`: Reuse sparse HLL sketches on epoch rotation to cut allocations (#51059)
- `processor/k8s_attributes`: Add experimental kubelet `/pods` polling as an opt-in pod metadata source. (#14475)
- `processor/partitioning`: Promote logs, metrics and traces to alpha and add the processor to the contrib distribution. (#39199)
- `processor/partitioning`: Add `otelcol.processor.partitioning.partitions` and `otelcol.processor.partitioning.key_evaluation.errors` internal telemetry metrics. (#39199)
- `processor/resource_detection`: Add `attributes.included` and `attributes.excluded` options to the `env` detector to filter which attribute keys from `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` are emitted. Both lists support `*` and `?` as wildcards, and `excluded` is applied after `included`. (#49970)
- `processor/resource_detection`: Define EC2 retry defaults locally instead of importing them from the AWS SDK. Defaults remain 3 attempts and 20s maximum backoff. (#47218)
- `receiver/google_cloud_spanner`: Add date value type for labels to support Spanner DATE columns & add Supported Optimizer Version table (#51734)
- `receiver/google_cloud_spanner`: Add table sizes per locality group metrics (`used_ssd_bytes`, `used_hdd_bytes`) to monitor SSD and HDD storage usage. (#51550)
- `receiver/google_cloud_spanner`: Add row deletion policies metrics and `timestamp` label `value_type` support in `googlecloudspannerreceiver`. (#52030)
- `receiver/google_cloud_spanner`: Add new SSD, HDD, and Columnar table size metrics for Spanner. (#51269)
- `receiver/google_cloud_spanner`: Add column operations stats metrics (`read_count`, `query_count`, `write_count`) to monitor how table columns are accessed and modified. (#51545)
- `receiver/google_cloud_spanner`: Add missing labels and execution metrics to top minute query stats in `googlecloudspannerreceiver`. (#51809)
- `receiver/google_cloud_spanner`: Add missing columns of top and total minute read stats (#51733)
- `receiver/google_cloud_spanner`: Add table operations stats metrics (`read_query_count`, `write_count`, `delete_count`) to monitor how tables are accessed and modified. (#51336)
- `receiver/google_cloud_spanner`: Add oldest active queries metrics and `hide_client_ip_address` configuration to mask `client_ip_address` in oldest_active_queries in `googlecloudspannerreceiver`. (#52089)
- `receiver/k8s_objects`: Add an opt-in informer-based observer behind the `receiver.k8sobjects.useInformerObserver` feature gate. (#43602)
- `receiver/kafka`: Make `max_decompress_batch_bytes` configurable in the Kafka receiver consumer configuration. (#51845)
- `receiver/kafka`: Add `partition_processing.max_in_flight.window`. Set it to `cross_fetch` so exporters that wait to fill a batch, for example with `sending_queue.wait_for_result` and `batch.min_size`, get records from more than one fetch instead of sending small batches on the flush timeout. (#51804)
- `receiver/kafka`: Add `partition_processing.max_in_flight.bytes` to limit the record bytes each partition holds while it processes records concurrently. Use it to bound memory when record sizes vary. (#51804)
- `receiver/kafka`: Add `partition_processing.max_prefetch.bytes` to cap the bytes of fetched batches waiting for each partition worker. Use it to bound memory when batch sizes vary. (#52253)
- `receiver/kubelet_stats`: Promote `container.cpu.time` to beta stability and align it with Semantic Conventions v1.43.0. (#52197)
- `receiver/mongodb`: Add operation latency count and non-tailable collection scan metrics (#51909)
  Adds `mongodb.operation.latency.count` and
  `mongodb.query_executor.collection_scan.non_tailable.count`, both disabled by default.
  
- `receiver/mysql`: Add `mysql.client.name` to `db.server.query_sample`, the client driver's self-reported identity. (#51317)
- `receiver/prometheus_remote_write`: Add the `otelcol_receiver_prometheusremotewrite_resource_cache_evictions` internal metric counting evictions from the resource metrics cache. (#52195)
- `receiver/prometheus_remote_write`: Add `resource_cache_size` to configure the number of job/instance pairs kept in the resource metrics cache. (#52195)
  The default remains 1000.
- `receiver/prometheus_simple`: `headers` and `proxy_url` are now applied to the scrape. Reserved header names and `proxy_url` credentials are rejected at validation. (#52081)
- `receiver/prometheus_simple`: `timeout` now sets the scrape timeout, capped at `collection_interval`. Previously it had no effect. (#52081)
- `receiver/sql_server`: Add `db.server.procedure_definition` event to capture the DDL definition of stored procedures observed in `db.server.top_procedure`. (#51946)
- `receiver/sql_server`: Add `sqlserver.tempdb.file.size` and `sqlserver.tempdb.allocation.waiters.count` metrics, and extend `sqlserver.database.tempdb.space`. (#52057)
  The two new metrics are disabled by default.

### 🧰 Bug fixes 🧰

- `connector/failover`: Fix recovery after a new failover immediately follows primary pipeline recovery. (#48668)
- `connector/failover`: Prevent data loss when a downstream pipeline mutates data before returning an error. (#52119)
- `exporter/elasticsearch`: Change the exponential histogram support from ES `v9.3.0` to ES `v9.4.0` (#52222)
  In Elasticsearch OTLP endpoint exponential histograms were added as a tech preview in ES `v9.3.0`.
  This did not have full backwards compatibility for queryDSL on histograms. Full support was added
  in ES `v9.4.0`.
  
- `exporter/faro`: Return an error instead of panicking when a stack trace frame cannot be parsed. (#52064)
- `exporter/prometheus`: Fix double-counting of buckets when downscaling delta exponential histograms. (#51705)
- `exporter/prometheus`: Drop exponential histogram data points without a sum instead of exporting a zero sum. (#52231)
- `exporter/prometheus_remote_write`: Drop exponential histogram data points without a sum instead of exporting a zero sum. (#52232)
- `exporter/prometheus_remote_write`: Apply the `timeout` to each attempt to send a request instead of to the whole retry loop, so that failed requests are retried until `retry_on_failure.max_elapsed_time` instead of being dropped after `timeout`. (#51983)
  Previously a backend outage longer than `timeout` (5s by default) dropped all the data, as the exporter retried a request only for the duration of the `timeout`.
  The retry delay now also grows up to `retry_on_failure.max_interval`. It was not passed to the backoff and stayed at `retry_on_failure.initial_interval`, which would send a request every 50ms by default for the whole `max_elapsed_time`. The retries are also interrupted when the exporter shuts down.
  `retry_on_failure.max_elapsed_time` bounds the export of a batch of metrics as a whole, also when the batch is split into several requests (`max_batch_size_bytes`), and the deadline of the shutdown bounds the flush of the queue.
  When only one of `timeout` and `http.timeout` is set, the other one now takes the same value instead of staying at its `5s` default, which would otherwise cap every attempt at `5s`.
  
- `exporter/signalfx`: Treat non-retryable 4xx responses as permanent errors instead of retrying them indefinitely (#51389)
  The SignalFx exporter shares the `HandleHTTPCode` helper with the Splunk HEC
  exporter. Previously only 400, 401, and 403 were classified as permanent; every
  other 4xx (404, 405, 410, 413, 414, 415, 422, ...) fell through and was
  retried forever even though retrying an identical request cannot succeed. Those
  4xx responses are now permanent, except 408 Request Timeout and 409 Conflict
  (transient) and 429 Too Many Requests (throttle). 5xx responses remain
  retryable, and 503 continues to honor Retry-After.
  
- `exporter/splunk_hec`: Fix inverted condition in multi-metric batching that prematurely terminated batching and dropped valid metrics when encountering an oversized event. (#52142)
- `exporter/splunk_hec`: Treat non-retryable 4xx responses as permanent errors instead of retrying them indefinitely (#51389)
  Previously only 400, 401, and 403 were classified as permanent; every other
  4xx (404, 405, 410, 413, 414, 415, 422, ...) fell through and was retried
  forever even though retrying an identical request cannot succeed. The shared
  `HandleHTTPCode` helper now treats all 4xx as permanent except 408 Request
  Timeout and 409 Conflict (transient) and 429 Too Many Requests (throttle).
  5xx responses remain retryable, and 503 continues to honor Retry-After. This
  helper is shared with the SignalFx exporter, whose retry classification
  changes in the same way.
  
- `extension/awscloudwatchmetricstreams_encoding`: Stop sizing the read buffer from the record's length prefix in the `opentelemetry1.0` format, so a malformed length can no longer crash the collector with an oversized allocation. (#51744)
- `extension/docker_observer`: Fix endpoint flapping by selecting a stable IP address for containers attached to multiple networks. (#51726)
- `extension/google_cloud_logentry_encoding`: Do not drop log entries with an unparseable `httpRequest.requestUrl`. (#52044)
  The raw value is kept in `url.full`; `url.path`, `url.query` and `url.domain` are omitted.
- `internal/kafka`: Reject extensions that do not implement Token(context.Context) during OAUTHBEARER SASL configuration instead of panicking at runtime. (#51958)
- `pkg/faro`: Keep the `warn` log level when translating logs to a Faro payload (#52114)
- `pkg/ottl`: Fix context inference for statements that pass an all-uppercase converter name, such as `SHA256`, as a function argument. (#52192)
- `pkg/winperfcounters`: Close the PDH query when adding the counter fails, preventing a handle leak on counter initialization errors. (#51048)
- `processor/cumulative_to_delta`: Handle NaN sums on exponential histograms like on histograms, so the next sum is no longer emitted as a NaN delta (#51965)
- `processor/cumulative_to_delta`: Include the scope attributes in the identity of a stream, so scopes that only differ in their attributes are no longer converted as one stream (#52162)
- `processor/resource_detection`: Fix a panic in the ECS detector when the task ARN has only 5 colon-separated parts (#52074)
  `parseTaskARN` checked for at least 5 parts but read the 6th one, so a task ARN without a resource part
  caused an index out of range panic during detection.
  
- `processor/resource_detection`: Bypass environment proxies for EKS detector requests to the in-cluster Kubernetes API. (#52301)
  Besides this, the EKS detector configuration now accepts API server configuration to control
  how it connections to the Kubernetes API server.
  
- `receiver/aws_cloudwatch`: Persist acknowledged log checkpoints so failed polls can retry unread logs after a restart when storage is enabled. (#51944)
- `receiver/mongodb`: Skip top command when mongodb.operation.time is disabled and log warning on BSONObjectTooLarge error (#50712)
- `receiver/postgresql`: Fix a scrape error that discarded every metric for a table or index dropped while the receiver was collecting (#52041)
- `receiver/pprof`: Fix the HTTP scraper to return an error for non-2xx responses, close the response body, and honor the scrape context. (#52256)
- `receiver/prometheus`: Fix config reload failing for multi-line secrets such as an inline `tls_config.key` (#52080)
- `receiver/prometheus_remote_write`: Refuse an out of range symbol reference on a target_info series, as on every other metric name. (#52070)
  A request carrying one now gets a 400 where it used to get a 204 with the
  sample counted as written.
  
- `receiver/prometheus_simple`: Forward inline TLS PEM (`ca_pem`, `cert_pem`, `key_pem`) and `server_name_override` to the underlying Prometheus receiver instead of silently dropping them. (#52029)
- `receiver/prometheus_simple`: Forward the `tls` `min_version` and `max_version` settings to the scrape config; previously they had no effect. (#52081)
- `receiver/snmp`: Create the datapoint with an empty attribute when an indexed attribute column returns an empty value, instead of failing the scrape. (#51875)
  An empty OCTET STRING, such as ifPhysAddress on a loopback or null interface, is a valid value.
  Previously every scrape of such a device reported "metric OID attribute value is blank" and dropped those datapoints.
  A row the attribute column does not return at all still fails as before.
  
- `receiver/snmp`: Add `max_repetitions` configuration option (defaulting to 25) for GETBULK requests to prevent request timeouts on MTU boundaries. (#51925)
- `receiver/splunk_enterprise`: Send the search job TTL to Splunk in seconds instead of nanoseconds (#50940)
  The receiver sets a TTL on every search job it dispatches, derived from the configured
  `timeout`. The value was formatted from a Go duration with `%d`, which emits its raw
  nanosecond count, and Splunk's `setttl` action reads the argument as seconds. A default
  `timeout: 60s` therefore asked Splunk to retain each dispatched job for roughly 1900 years,
  so search artifacts accumulated until the search dispatch directory filled and Splunk
  reported extreme search lag. The duration is now converted to whole seconds.
  
- `receiver/yang_grpc`: Log a warning when duplicate YANG module definitions are loaded, identifying conflicting source paths. (#50917)

<!-- previous-version -->

## API Changelog

### 🛑 Breaking changes 🛑

- `exporter/nats`: Move NATS connection settings and auth types to the shared `internal/natsclient` module. The YAML configuration is unchanged. (#50735)
  `Config.Endpoint`, `Config.Pedantic`, `Config.TLS`, and `Config.Auth` are now under `Config.ClientConfig`. `AuthConfig`, `TokenConfig`, `UserConfig`, `NkeyConfig`, `NkeyJWTConfig`, and `NkeyUserFileConfig` moved to `internal/natsclient`.
- `pkg/azurelogs`: Promote the `pkg.translator.azurelogs.EmitV1LogConventions` and `pkg.translator.azurelogs.DontEmitV0LogConventions` feature gates to beta. (#52096)
  `code.function.name` and `code.file.path` are now emitted instead of `code.function` and `code.filepath` by default.
  The gates no longer control the `event.name` resource attribute, which is always emitted.
  
- `pkg/ottl`: Remove the stable `ottl.set.allowNil` feature gate. (#48714)
- `pkg/prometheus`: Promote the pkg.translator.prometheus.PermissiveLabelSanitization feature gate to stable and deprecate DropSanitizationGate. (#50429)
  The gate can no longer be disabled and will be removed in v0.166.0.
  
- `pkg/prometheus`: Remove NormalizeLabel. Use github.com/prometheus/otlptranslator.LabelNamer.Build for label name translation instead. (#50429)

### 🚩 Deprecations 🚩

- `processor/transform`: Deprecate the `flatten_data` option in favor of the new `flatten.log` option. (#51766)
  Replace `flatten_data: true` with `flatten: {log: true}`. `flatten_data` will be removed in a future release.

### 💡 Enhancements 💡

- `extension/datadog`: Add `NewFactoryWithOptions` so a host embedding the collector can supply extra Agent-config options, for example to propagate an API key rotation into the extension's forwarder. (#51877)
- `extension/redis_storage`: Add `IncrementBy` and `BatchIncrementBy` for atomic integer counters shared across Collector instances. (#51567)

### 🧰 Bug fixes 🧰

- `exporter/prometheus_remote_write`: Drop exponential histogram data points without a sum instead of exporting a zero sum. (#52232)

items.title: The case for OpenTelemetry maintainership
items.summary: I believe OpenTelemetry’s primary constraint isn’t ideas, code contributions, or adoption, but maintainers. About me I’ve been working on OpenTelemetry since early 2021. I’m a maintainer of opentelemetry-java, opentelemetry-configuration, and opentelemetry-injector, and a member of the Technical Committee. In that time I’ve worked at two observability companies, New Relic and now Grafana Labs, in roles with a charter to work on OpenTelemetry while also engaging in internal engineering efforts that depend on it. This post is my opinion, informed by involvement in a lot of different OpenTelemetry projects and by watching various contributors come and go.

### Images and binaries here: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/releases/tag/v0.164.0

## End User Changelog

### 💡 Enhancements 💡

- `cmd/mdatagen`: Add support for supported_platforms in component metadata, allowing generated component tests to target explicitly supported platforms (#13319)

### 🧰 Bug fixes 🧰

- `cmd/mdatagen`: Fix the generated `dataPointKey` function triggering gosec G115 (`uint64` to `int64` conversion) in components that use mdatagen. (#16176)
  The generated hash values are unchanged.
- `exporter/otlp_http`: Report the URL the request was actually sent to in HTTP status error messages when a middleware rewrites the request URL. (#14673)
  Middleware RoundTrippers that clone the request before rewriting its URL left
  the configured placeholder URL in 4xx/5xx error messages. The exporter now
  reads the destination from the response instead.
  
- `pkg/otelcol`: Redact non-empty literal defaults in unexpanded env provider references such as `${env:NAME:-literal}` in the raw config reported by the OpAMP extension when `reports_raw_config` is enabled (#16141)
  Empty defaults such as `${env:NAME:-}` stay visible. Other provider schemes are unchanged.
  

<!-- previous-version -->

## API Changelog

### 💡 Enhancements 💡

- `pkg/xpdata`: Add `xhash.WithUint64` to hash a `uint64` value without converting it to `int64`. (#16176)
  It produces the same hash as `xhash.WithValue(pcommon.NewValueInt(int64(v)))`.

### 🧰 Bug fixes 🧰

- `pkg/exporterhelper`: Expose PartitionConfig and NewDefaultPartitionConfig so that users can modify it. (#16197)

items.title: VictoriaMetrics v1.155.0
items.release_notes:
## [v1.155.0](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/releases/tag/v1.155.0)

Released at 2026-10-23

**Update Note 1:** `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): `/admin/tenants` requests without `start` and `end` query args now return tenants for the current day. This is a breaking change because previously it was expected to return all tenants. If you still need to retrieve all tenants, set the `start` and `end` params so that the resulting time range fully includes the `-retentionPeriod`. Also note that [vmctl](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmctl/victoriametrics/) is known to send requests to `/admin/tenants` under the hood when migrating data between VictoriaMetrics deployments. Therefore, make sure that you run `vmctl` with both `*-filter-time-start` and `*-filter-time-end` params. See the updated [URL format](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/#url-format) and [#11791](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11791) for details.

* SECURITY: upgrade Go builder from Go1.27.2 to Go1.27.3. See [the list of issues addressed in Go1.27.3](https://github.com/golang/go/issues?q=milestone%3AGo1.27.3%20label%3ACherryPickApproved).
* SECURITY: upgrade base docker image (Alpine) from 3.24.2 to 3.24.3. See [Alpine 3.24.4 release notes](https://alpinelinux.org/posts/Alpine-3.21.9-3.22.7-3.23.7-3.24.3-released.html).

* FEATURE: all VictoriaMetrics components: add `-healthcheck` command-line flag, which checks that the running process accepts connections at `-httpListenAddr` and exits with non-zero code if the check fails. This allows setting up Docker `HEALTHCHECK` in images without `curl` or `wget`. See [these docs](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/url-examples/#health) and [VictoriaLogs#1565](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/issues/1565).
* FEATURE: all VictoriaMetrics components: expose `process_cpu_cores_host`, `process_cpu_cores_cgroup_quota`, `process_memory_host_bytes` and `process_memory_cgroup_bytes` metrics. Cgroup metrics are `-1` if no cgroup limit is set or the limit cannot be read. See [#11460](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11460).
* FEATURE: [vmui](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#vmui): deprecate Server URL editing and show a warning when using a saved custom URL. Existing custom URLs continue to work. See [#11735](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11735).
* FEATURE: [vmui](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#vmui): update the appearance of error, warning, info, and success messages. See [#11736](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11736).
* FEATURE: [vmui](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#vmui): add a tenant column to Top Queries and Active Queries when tenant information is available. See [#6346](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/6346).
* FEATURE: [vmui](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#vmui): limit tenant discovery to the selected time range. See [#11784](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11784).
* FEATURE: [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/) and [Single-node VictoriaMetrics](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/): limit the number of logged parse errors per each scrape of a target via `-promscrape.maxParseErrorsPerScrape` command-line flag (20 by default). The number of suppressed parse errors is logged after the scrape. This prevents log flooding from targets exposing many malformed lines. See [#8856](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/8856).
* FEATURE: [vmalert](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmalert/): restore Prometheus compatibility for alerts state restoration, so Prometheus can be used as `-remoteRead.url` again. Previously, the restore query used MetricsQL function `default_rollup()` which Prometheus rejects, so the state of alerting rules with `for > 0` was reset on every vmalert restart. See [#11574](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11574).
* FEATURE: `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): export `vm_request_duration_seconds{path="/admin/tenants"}` for tracking time it takes to fetch [tenants](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/#multitenancy) from the database.
* FEATURE: [dashboards](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/tree/master/dashboards): apply the instance filter to the `CPU pressure`, `Memory pressure`, `IO pressure`, and `Memory allocations rate` panels in the Resource usage section of the [VictoriaMetrics - cluster](https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/11176-victoriametrics-cluster/) dashboard. Displays zero disk I/O and syscall rates. See [#11742](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11742).
* FEATURE: [alerts-health](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/blob/master/deployment/docker/rules/alerts-health.yml): add `TooManySnapshots` alerting rule. It notifies about instances where more than 2 [snapshots](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#how-to-work-with-snapshots) are stored for at least 2 hours. Such snapshots are usually left behind by failed `vmbackup` / `vmbackupmanager` runs. They keep references to the already merged data parts and prevent [background merges](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#storage) from freeing the disk space, which results in excessive disk usage. See [#9344](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/9344).

* BUGFIX: [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/): prevent [Kafka remote write](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/integrations/kafka/) getting stuck after TLS certificates are reloaded. Previously, when vmagent detected changed certificates and restarted the Kafka producer, pending sends to the old producer could hang forever and the remote write queue stopped draining until vmagent was restarted. Now such sends are retried with the new producer. See [#11737](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11737).
* BUGFIX: `vminsert` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): prevent metric metadata drops after transient RPC handshake timeouts when connecting to `vmstorage`. See [#11762](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11762). Thanks to @sakateka for contribution.
* BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/), [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/) and `vminsert` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): properly validate time series ingested via [`/api/v1/import/native`](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#how-to-import-data-in-native-format). See [#11745](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11745). Thanks to @meshchellomishel for contribution.
* BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/): reduce memory usage during for Kubernetes service discovery, when scrape configuration has many entries that matches small subset of targets. See [#11751](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11751). Thanks to @CamberLoid for contribution.
* BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmstorage` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): prevent search requests panic. See [#11788](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11788) for details.
* BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/): set `__meta_kubernetes_namespace` and the namespace metadata to the namespace of the `Endpoints` or `EndpointSlice` object in [`role: endpoints`](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/sd_configs/#kubernetes_sd_configs) and `role: endpointslice` service discovery when the referenced pod lives in another namespace. Previously the namespace of the pod was used, unlike Prometheus. See [#11798](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11798). Thanks to @cestercian for contribution.
* BUGFIX: [vmauth](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/): skip keys with unsupported `kty` or `crv`, missing required members or invalid values in the JWKS fetched via [OIDC discovery](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#oidc-discovery) instead of rejecting the whole key set, as required by [RFC 7517](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7517#section-5). Previously, a single unsupported or malformed key in the JWKS caused vmauth to reject all JWTs from that issuer, including tokens signed with supported keys. See [#11748](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11748).
* BUGFIX: [vmui](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#vmui): stop saving the automatically calculated query step in shared URLs, so opening a link recalculates the step for the selected time range and screen width. Explicitly configured steps remain fixed. See [#11638](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11638).
* BUGFIX: `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): change the default time range for [/admin/tenants](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/#multitenancy) HTTP endpoint to search tenants only for the current day instead of searching the entire `[0, now]` time range. This should prevent unnecessary load on `vmstorage` and prevent OOMs. See the updated [URL format](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/#url-format) and [#11791](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11791) for details.

change_sections.heading: v1.155.0
items: SECURITY: upgrade Go builder from Go1.27.2 to Go1.27.3. See the list of issues addressed in Go1.27.3.
SECURITY: upgrade base docker image (Alpine) from 3.24.2 to 3.24.3. See Alpine 3.24.4 release notes.

FEATURE: all VictoriaMetrics components: add -healthcheck command-line flag, which checks that the running process accepts connections at -httpListenAddr and exits with non-zero code if the check fails. This allows setting up Docker HEALTHCHECK in images without curl or wget. See these docs and VictoriaLogs 1565.

FEATURE: all VictoriaMetrics components: expose process cpu cores host, process cpu cores cgroup quota, process memory host bytes and process memory cgroup bytes metrics. Cgroup metrics are -1 if no cgroup limit is set or the limit cannot be read. See 11460.
FEATURE: vmui: deprecate Server URL editing and show a warning when using a saved custom URL. Existing custom URLs continue to work. See 11735.
FEATURE: vmui: update the appearance of error, warning, info, and success messages. See 11736.
FEATURE: vmui: add a tenant column to Top Queries and Active Queries when tenant information is available. See 6346.
FEATURE: vmui: limit tenant discovery to the selected time range. See 11784.

FEATURE: vmagent and Single-node VictoriaMetrics: limit the number of logged parse errors per each scrape of a target via -promscrape.maxParseErrorsPerScrape command-line flag (20 by default). The number of suppressed parse errors is logged after the scrape. This prevents log flooding from targets exposing many malformed lines. See 8856.

FEATURE: vmalert: restore Prometheus compatibility for alerts state restoration, so Prometheus can be used as -remoteRead.url again. Previously, the restore query used MetricsQL function default rollup() which Prometheus rejects, so the state of alerting rules with for > 0 was reset on every vmalert restart. See 11574.
FEATURE: vmselect in VictoriaMetrics cluster: export vm request duration seconds{path="/admin/tenants"} for tracking time it takes to fetch tenants from the database.

FEATURE: dashboards: apply the instance filter to the CPU pressure, Memory pressure, IO pressure, and Memory allocations rate panels in the Resource usage section of the VictoriaMetrics - cluster dashboard. Displays zero disk I/O and syscall rates. See 11742.

items.title: How to Contribute to OpenTelemetry | Episode 2
OpenTelemetry Operator v0.162.0
items.release_notes:
## 0.162.0

### 🛑 Breaking changes 🛑

- `auto-instrumentation`: Block automatic NodeJS instrumentation upgrades across 0.79.0 because of breaking HTTP, network, and database semantic convention changes. (#2542)
  To upgrade, manually set spec.nodejs.image to an image using instrumentation 0.79.0 or higher. See https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-operator/issues/2542 for migration details.

### 🚀 New components 🚀

- `auto-instrumentation`: Add support for auto-instrumentation in PHP applications. (#932)
  Auto-instrumentation in PHP applications is disabled by default in operator. Users can enable it by setting the
  `--enable-php-instrumentation` or `ENABLE_PHP_AUTO_INSTRUMENTATION` environment variable to `true` in operator
  and setting up the annotations `instrumentation.opentelemetry.io/inject-php` and `instrumentation.opentelemetry.io/otel-php-api-version`.
  For more information, please refer to the documentation.
  
- `auto-instrumentation`: Add initial version of autoinstrumentation for ruby (#3762)
  Ruby auto-instrumentation is disabled by default. Enable it with `--enable-ruby-instrumentation=true`.

### 💡 Enhancements 💡

- `collector`: Inject the cluster TLS profile's supported groups as `curve_preferences` into generated collector configurations. (#6893)
  Receivers and extensions with a `tls` block in `spec.config` now get `curve_preferences` defaulted from the
  cluster's TLS security profile `groups`, following the same defaults-only rule as `min_version` and
  `cipher_suites`: values set by the user are never overridden.
  Groups without a collector `curve_preferences` spelling are logged at operator startup and not injected.
  

### 🧰 Bug fixes 🧰

- `operator, target allocator, opamp, auto-instrumentation`: Remove the distrusted emSign root CAs from the operator, target allocator, OpAMP bridge, and Python auto-instrumentation images. (#5802)
  The operator, target allocator, and OpAMP bridge images require Alpine `ca-certificates` 20261020-r0 or later.
  The Python auto-instrumentation image requires `certifi` 2026.10.19 or later and is published as `0.66b1-3`.
  The updated CA bundle removes the distrusted eMudhra emSign roots, including `emSign ECC Root CA - G3`.
  Images are built with Go 1.27.3, which includes the `crypto/x509` security fixes released on 2026-10-19.
  
- `collector`: Include the requesting user's UID and extra fields in the SubjectAccessReviews used to check RBAC privilege escalation. (#5659)
  Authorizers that rely on these fields, such as AKS with Azure RBAC for Kubernetes Authorization, denied the check
  for users who held the required permissions.
  
- `collector, target allocator`: Use pointer for TargetAllocator Telemetry field so omitempty works correctly with encoding/json (#5695)
  Go's encoding/json does not omit zero-value structs with omitempty. The non-pointer
  TelemetryConfig field caused targetAllocator.telemetry to always be serialized during
  server-side apply, even when not set, breaking consumers that use a CRD version without
  this field.
- `collector`: Keep `service.telemetry` unchanged when the operator cannot parse it, instead of replacing it with the default Prometheus reader. (#5734)
  The collector accepts telemetry settings the operator does not parse, such as `resource.attributes`.
  Such a configuration now gets an admission warning, and no default metrics reader is added to it.
  

### Components

* [OpenTelemetry Collector - v0.162.0](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/releases/tag/v0.162.0)
* [OpenTelemetry Contrib - v0.162.0](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/releases/tag/v0.162.0)
* [Java auto-instrumentation - v2.32.0-1](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/releases/tag/v2.32.0)
* [.NET auto-instrumentation - v1.17.0-2](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-dotnet-instrumentation/releases/tag/v1.17.0)
* [Node.JS - v0.82.0-1](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-js/releases/tag/experimental%2Fv0.82.0)
* [Python - v0.66b1-3](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-python-contrib/releases/tag/v0.66b1)
* [Ruby - v0.1.0](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-ruby-instrumentation/releases/tag/v0.1.0)
* [Go - v0.24.0](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go-instrumentation/releases/tag/v0.24.0)
* [PHP - 1.4.1](https://packagist.org/packages/open-telemetry/ext-opentelemetry/#1.4.1)
* [ApacheHTTPD - 1.0.4-2](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-cpp-contrib/releases/tag/webserver%2Fv1.0.4)
* [Nginx - 1.0.4-2](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-cpp-contrib/releases/tag/webserver%2Fv1.0.4)

items.title: Help us understand how you use OpenTelemetry's ecosystem lists
items.summary: Do you use OpenTelemetry’s registry or ecosystem lists? Comment on the issue and tell us which pages you need and why. We are reviewing the future of these pages. Understanding how people use them will help us focus our efforts within the maintainer time available. Which pages are affected? We have frozen new entries and updates to the following lists while we consider retiring or changing them: Registry : libraries, Collector components, and other tools for using and extending OpenTelemetry. Vendors : organizations offering solutions that consume OpenTelemetry. Distributions : third-party distributions of OpenTelemetry components. Integrations : software with OpenTelemetry support. Adopters : organizations using OpenTelemetry. The issue describes the current direction for each list, including retiring the registry in favor of the OpenTelemetry Ecosystem Explorer . The future of the other lists is still being discussed.

items.title: Cilium v1.20.4
items.summary: Security patch release
items.release_notes:
Security patch release
----------------------

Out-of-band security patch release to fix CVE-2026-111943 ([golang/go#82345](https://github.com/golang/go/issues/82345)): upgrades Go to 1.26.10 so that the compromised eMudhra intermediate CA certificates are no longer trusted, and updates all dependencies to their latest patch versions.

Summary of Changes
------------------

**Minor Changes:**
* alibabacloud: support RRSA (RAM Roles for Service Accounts) credentials in the IPAM allocator, alongside static AccessKeys and ECS instance RAM roles (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49474, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49093, @4n4nd)

**Bugfixes:**
* Allow wildcard CIDR selectors to match nodes when --policy-cidr-match-mode=nodes is configured (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49474, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#47828, @TheBeeZee)
* bpf: nat: fix outer ICMP checksum for ICMP/SCTP NAT error packets (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49474, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48819, @fds7280)
* CiliumEnvoyConfig now only redirects Services in its own namespace, as documented; service references in CiliumClusterwideEnvoyConfig without a namespace default to "default" again. (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49474, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49076, @maxskokov)
* datapath: Fix NAT46x64 gateway prefix conversion panic (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49474, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49177, @HadrienPatte)
* Fix an issue where terminating backends were evicted from BPF maps when trafficDistribution was enabled. (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49474, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48349, @taesung320)
* Fix invalid L4 checksum on IPv6 ClusterIP reverse NAT for CHECKSUM_PARTIAL packets on kernels < 6.12, affecting the case when packets are bridged/tunneled from the client pod to a remote host (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49474, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49204, @liuyuan10)
* Fix regression in Cilium 1.20.3 where the Gateway API implementation would incorrectly handle BackendTLSPolicy configurations, leading to high Cilium CPU usage and inability to forward traffic. (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49568, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49525, @youngnick)
* Fixes an issue in LBIPAM where on service upsert, if IP allocations are not changed the sharing index is not updated. (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49474, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48938, @0xch4z)
* nodediscovery: in IPAM ENI and Azure modes the operator now treats nodes as running in multi-pool mode from the very first event. (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49390, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49242, @41ks)
* Reduce transient DNS SERVFAIL/REFUSED for pods that query immediately at startup by pushing/applying Standalone DNS Proxy policy snapshots more frequently (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49474, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49112, @QxBytes)
* Remove the unused pebble binary from the cilium image to clear its Go standard library vulnerability findings. (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49474, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49380, @aanm)

**CI Changes:**
* [v1.20] ci: ignore transient xDS mode drift during downgrade (cilium/cilium#49515, @jrajahalme)
* ci: Pass the auto-committer secrets to the base images workflow (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49467, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49453, @aanm)
* renovate: Open one trusted PR per branch (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49416, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49381, @aanm)

**Misc Changes:**
* chore(deps): update auto-merge-trusted-deps (v1.20) (cilium/cilium#49319, @cilium-renovate[bot])
* chore(deps): update auto-merge-trusted-deps (v1.20) (cilium/cilium#49445, @cilium-renovate[bot])
* chore(deps): update dependency sphinxcontrib-openapi to v0.10.0 (v1.20) (cilium/cilium#49438, @cilium-renovate[bot])
* clarify co sign documentation to use minimum version to verify signing key (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49474, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49401, @mfahlandt)
* Fix Envoy xDS listener handling across restoration, address changes, and rejected updates (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49383, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48897, @jrajahalme)

**Other Changes:**
* install: Update image digests for v1.20.3 (cilium/cilium#49392, @cilium-release-bot[bot])
* route-reconciler: add prune exclusion logic and use it in the linuxNodeHandler (cilium/cilium#49170, @andreaterzolo)

items.title: OpenTelemetry Specification v1.62.0
items.summary: Traces
items.release_notes:
## Traces

- Add `Sampler.Shutdown` operation.
  ([#5335](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-specification/pull/5335))
- Clarify that calls to the Development `SpanProcessor.OnEnding` method are not
  allowed after `Shutdown`.
  ([#5316](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-specification/pull/5316))

## Metrics

- Specify that `Shutdown` of the periodic exporting MetricReader MUST include
  the effects of `ForceFlush`.
  ([#5305](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-specification/pull/5305))

## Logs

- Add systemd-journald example mapping to the logs data model appendix and align syslog mapping.
  ([#4995](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-specification/pull/4995))

## Resource

- Update resource detectors to generate entities and indicate resource detectors should be entity-aware
  unless new `OTEL_EXPERIMENTAL_ENTITIES_ENABLED != true`.
  ([#5147](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-specification/pull/5147))

## Entities

- Add in-development entity-resource startup specification.
  ([#5057](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-specification/pull/5057))
- Remove `OTEL_ENTITIES` from general env var configuration spec.
  ([#5147](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-specification/pull/5147))

## Common

- Stabilize Attribute and Attribute Collection representation for non-OTLP.
  ([#5149](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-specification/pull/5149))

## OpenTelemetry Protocol

- Clarify that the OTLP exporter timeout bounds the entire batch export,
  including all request attempts and waits between retries, and that earlier
  caller deadlines take precedence.
  ([#5347](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-specification/pull/5347))

## Compatibility

- Stabilize Prometheus Unknown-typed metric transformation.
  ([#5213](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-specification/pull/5213))
- Stabilize Prometheus Info metric transformation.
  ([#5211](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-specification/pull/5211))

## SDK Configuration

- Declarative config should gracefully degrade when encountering unrecognized
  resource detectors. Other SDK plugin components continue to produce errors
  when missing.
  ([#5323](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-specification/pull/5323))

## Supplementary Guidelines

- Allow narrowly scoped security-related changes to stable SDK and Contrib
  behavior, configuration defaults, supported values, and emitted telemetry
  without a major version bump, while preserving API compatibility and requiring
  release notes describing the security rationale, user impact, and migration.
  ([#5357](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-specification/pull/5357))

## OTEPs

- Add OTEP proposing a top-level span type field in API, SDK, and OTLP.
  ([#5233](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-specification/pull/5233))

items.title: Strengthening OpenTelemetry security while preserving API stability
items.summary: OpenTelemetry has updated its client versioning policy to make room for security fixes that need to change behavior. Stable SDKs and Contrib components, such as instrumentation libraries and exporters, can now make narrowly scoped, necessary security changes in minor or patch releases, even when those changes affect existing users. Public API compatibility remains protected. The intent is to help users receive security improvements within the major version they already use. Some upgrades may require configuration or operational changes. In such cases, release notes must explain the impact and what to do.

You stop what you're doing to get everyone pointed in the same direction. They're all reasonable requests, but each one takes your attention away from understanding the problem. Yes, your team has a process for handling incidents, but carrying it out is another job for someone who's already busy. Grafana Workflows , available in public preview, turns your team’s processes into automated steps across Grafana Cloud and your other tools. You can even include Grafana Assistant in those steps to investigate an issue, summarize findings, or draft an update. ## Version 2.19.7 Release Notes

Compatible with OpenSearch and OpenSearch Dashboards version 2.19.7

### Enhancements

* Add upper bound for the hot_threads `snapshots` parameter with configurable `monitor.jvm.hot_threads.max_snapshots` cluster setting ([#23144](https://github.com/opensearch-project/OpenSearch/pull/23144))
* Add `search.query.max_query_nesting_depth` setting to limit query_string parenthesis nesting depth and prevent StackOverflowError ([#22854](https://github.com/opensearch-project/OpenSearch/pull/22854))
* Cap `max_determinized_states` in completion suggester regex and fuzzy options to prevent heap exhaustion ([#22925](https://github.com/opensearch-project/OpenSearch/pull/22925))
* Disable Mustache partial template resolution in search templates ([#22440](https://github.com/opensearch-project/OpenSearch/pull/22440))
* Reject out-of-range WLM node threshold updates at validation time ([#22678](https://github.com/opensearch-project/OpenSearch/pull/22678))

### Bug Fixes

* Fix unbounded recursion in JSON and binary deserialization that could cause StackOverflowError ([#22427](https://github.com/opensearch-project/OpenSearch/pull/22427))
* Strengthen scroll_id validation to prevent OOM from crafted scroll IDs with oversized counts ([#22401](https://github.com/opensearch-project/OpenSearch/pull/22401))
* Validate `base_path` in fs repository to prevent path traversal outside configured `path.repo` directories ([#22381](https://github.com/opensearch-project/OpenSearch/pull/22381))
* Fix handling of unsupported zstd HTTP content encoding in netty4 and nio transports ([#23324](https://github.com/opensearch-project/OpenSearch/pull/23324))

### Maintenance

* Bump Jackson to 2.18.9 and Log4j to 2.25.5 ([#22990](https://github.com/opensearch-project/OpenSearch/pull/22990))
* Bump Bouncy Castle bc-fips to 2.1.3 ([#23284](https://github.com/opensearch-project/OpenSearch/pull/23284))
* Update Netty to 4.1.139.Final ([#22692](https://github.com/opensearch-project/OpenSearch/pull/22692), [#23003](https://github.com/opensearch-project/OpenSearch/pull/23003), [#23251](https://github.com/opensearch-project/OpenSearch/pull/23251))
* Update bundled JDK to 21.0.12.1+1 ([#22572](https://github.com/opensearch-project/OpenSearch/pull/22572), [#22809](https://github.com/opensearch-project/OpenSearch/pull/22809))

## [v1.154.1](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/releases/tag/v1.154.1)

Released at 2026-10-19

* BUGFIX: [vmauth](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/): do not slow down requests with auth tokens if no `users` are configured. Previously, such requests were delayed by 2-3 seconds before being proxied to `unauthorized_user`, though there were no users to brute-force. This affected setups where one `vmauth` authenticates requests and proxies them to another `vmauth` with only `unauthorized_user` configured. The bug has been introduced in [v1.154.0](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/releases/tag/v1.154.0). See [#11774](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11774).

items.release_notes:
## [1.21.0](https://github.com/grafana/alloy/compare/v1.20.0...v1.21.0) (2026-10-16)


### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* **otelcol.receiver.kafka:** `otelcol.receiver.kafka` and `otelcol.exporter.kafka` `metadata > retry > max_retries` now defaults to `20` (was `3`) and is now actually applied. Upstream's Kafka client silently ignored it since the franz-go migration. `otelcol.exporter.kafka` now also applies `backoff`. ([#7366](https://github.com/grafana/alloy/issues/7366))
* **otelcol.connector.signaltometrics:** `otelcol.connector.signaltometrics` `error_mode` now defaults to `ignore` (was `propagate`). A failing OTTL expression now skips the record and logs the error instead of dropping the whole payload. Set `error_mode = "propagate"` to restore the previous behavior. ([#7366](https://github.com/grafana/alloy/issues/7366))
* **loki.write:** `loki.write` configurations that set `wal { enabled = true }` now fail to load unless Alloy runs with `--stability.level=experimental`. To keep using the WAL, add `--stability.level=experimental` to the `alloy run` command. To keep the default stability level, remove the `wal` block or set `enabled = false`. ([#7257](https://github.com/grafana/alloy/issues/7257))
* **loki.write:** Remove tenant label from metrics ([#7232](https://github.com/grafana/alloy/issues/7232))

### Features 🌟

* Add CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE in the allowed Linux capabilities list ([#7303](https://github.com/grafana/alloy/issues/7303)) ([dddc5d8](https://github.com/grafana/alloy/commit/dddc5d895ec62e7a2b24517ad2a515860e0527f6)) (@grcevski)

items: otelcol.receiver.kafka: otelcol.receiver.kafka and otelcol.exporter.kafka metadata > retry > max retries now defaults to 20 (was 3) and is now actually applied. Upstream's Kafka client silently ignored it since the franz-go migration. otelcol.exporter.kafka now also applies backoff. ( 7366)

otelcol.connector.signaltometrics: otelcol.connector.signaltometrics error mode now defaults to ignore (was propagate). A failing OTTL expression now skips the record and logs the error instead of dropping the whole payload. Set error mode = "propagate" to restore the previous behavior. ( 7366)

loki.write: loki.write configurations that set wal { enabled = true } now fail to load unless Alloy runs with --stability.level=experimental. To keep using the WAL, add --stability.level=experimental to the alloy run command. To keep the default stability level, remove the wal block or set enabled = false. ( 7257)

items.title: Announcing the 2026 OpenTelemetry Governance Committee Election Candidates
items.summary: The OpenTelemetry Election Committee is excited to announce the final list of candidates for the 2026 OpenTelemetry Governance Committee election ! Eligible voters can help fill four Governance Committee seats through Helios Voting . Voting opens: 26 October 2026 at 12:00 UTC. Voting closes: 28 October 2026 at 23:59 Anywhere on Earth (AoE), equivalent to 29 October 2026 at 11:59 UTC. For candidate photos, GitHub profiles, and statements, see the candidates page . Antoine Toulme Dan Gomez Blanco Huxing Zhang Josh Suereth Juliano Costa Kemal Akkoyun Matthew Cascio Pablo Baeyens Fernández Trask Stalnaker Vibhanshu Singh To check your eligibility, see the voter roll . If the automated eligibility check doesn’t account for your contributions to the OpenTelemetry ecosystem, you can request an exception before 23 October 2026 at 23:59 AoE to vote.

items.title: Tempo v3.0.4
items.summary: Security
items.release_notes:
## Security

- `deps`: Update Go to 1.26.9 (CVE-2026-56858, CVE-2026-56862, CVE-2026-56860, CVE-2026-56859, CVE-2026-56853, CVE-2026-33818, CVE-2026-97031, CVE-2026-94440, CVE-2026-78669, CVE-2026-78667, CVE-2026-78660, CVE-2026-78659), google.golang.org/grpc to v1.83.2 (CVE-2026-84445, CVE-2026-84304), github.com/apache/thrift to v0.24.0 (CVE-2026-43871), golang.org/x/net to v0.60.0 (CVE-2026-39821, CVE-2026-78669, CVE-2026-78660, CVE-2026-78659, CVE-2026-46600), golang.org/x/text to v0.42.0 (CVE-2026-56851), golang.org/x/crypto to v0.57.0 (CVE-2026-56854), and the OpenTelemetry log modules to v0.21.0 ([#8099](https://github.com/grafana/tempo/issues/8099)) (@mdisibio)

## Bug fixes

- `live-store`: Fix a panic in live-store `FindTraceByID` when more spans for the trace arrive while it is being combined with block data and marshalled. ([#8111](https://github.com/grafana/tempo/issues/8111)) (@KR-Ravindra)
  The live trace's `Batches` slice was handed to the trace combiner with spare capacity, so the
  combiner's append and the push path's append wrote different batches into the same slot of the
  live trace's backing array. `Size()` and `Marshal()` then saw different objects and marshalling
  panicked with `slice bounds out of range`.
  
- `query-frontend`: Fix rare cache collision between instant and range metrics queries. ([#7290](https://github.com/grafana/tempo/issues/7290)) (@ruslan-mikhailov)

items.title: Cilium v1.20.3
items.summary: Summary of Changes
items.release_notes:
Summary of Changes
------------------

**Minor Changes:**
* alibabacloud: support IMDSv2 (token-based) instance metadata access (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49336, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49182, @4n4nd)
* Fix conntrack garbage collection deleting CT entries that the datapath reopened between the GC batch read and the delete, which could cascade into NAT mapping deletion and SNAT source-port reallocation for live connections. (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49119, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#46750, @gyutaeb)
* operator: prevent CNPs with nodeSelector from silently enforcing nothing (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49173, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#47882, @weizhoublue)

**Bugfixes:**
* azure: Fixed an issue where an interface with an empty MAC field would be reported back the the cilium agent causing it to crash on startup when trying to configure the routes. (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49336, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48648, @41ks)
* bpf: icmp: use 576 byte of inner packet to avoid partial csum floor (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48907, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48578, @tommyp1ckles)
* cilium-dbg: Print port numbers correctly for map cilium_lb*_reverse_sk (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49336, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#47134, @jayl1e)
* daemon: fix a bug where L7 DNS policies could remain loaded in the datapath during agent shutdown, causing pods under a wildcard toFQDNs policy to lose DNS resolution for the duration of the restart. (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48907, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48747, @41ks)
* endpoint/restore: skip cleanup for reserved internal endpoints (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48999, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48272, @fristonio)
* envoy: handle listener additional address changes (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48917, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48712, @nezdolik)
* envoy: handle listener address changes in ADS (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48917, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48798, @nezdolik)
* envoy: track coalesced ADS snapshot updates (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48917, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48631, @nezdolik)
* Fix Gateway API ExternalAuth dropping request bodies when allowedResponseHeaders is unset (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49189, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48770, @kirgene)
* Fix incorrect deletion of new endpoint during GC iteration when reusing ID from a previously GC'd endpoint (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49189, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48905, @fristonio)
* Fix ip6tables chain rename errors being silently ignored during iptables rule reconciliation. (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49336, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49024, @maxskokov)
* Fix panic in agent when CiliumLocalRedirectPolicy `redirectBackend.toPorts` is declared as an empty array. The agent will now reject such a policy. (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48907, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48491, @ajmmm)
* Fix PMTU/ICMP replies for IPIP/Geneve DSR for GRO skbs (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49189, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48489, @borkmann)
* Fix rare data race in selector cache that could lead to agent panic (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49189, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#47733, @odinuge)
* Fix restoration of terminating backends. If a terminating backend become active again during restart the backend was incorrectly kept as quarantined. (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48797, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48763, @joamaki)
* Fixes a bug where Hubble flows may list the incorrect policy that allowed or denied a flow (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49189, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49086, @tsotne95)
* Fixes a bug where the helm value `hubble.tls.auto.privateKey` settings are no longer ignored in Hubble cert-manager certificates (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49189, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49114, @byxorna)
* Fixes an issue where CiliumCIDRGroups with zero-length cidrs (i.e. 0.0.0.0/0) inadvertently selected no traffic. (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49336, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48366, @squeed)
* gateway-api: filter CEC controls from infrastructure metadata (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48984, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#47732, @nezdolik)
* gateway-api: make HTTP route ordering deterministic (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49336, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48951, @abduu11aahh)
* gateway-api: Support system CA certificates in BackendTLSPolicy. (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49336, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48895, @shreyasrajiv327)
* infraendpoints: Release the health IPv4 when the IPv6 allocation fails (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48907, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48816, @HadrienPatte)
* k8s/resource: fix leaked event finalizer on unobserved delete (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48907, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48785, @tklauser)
* L7 conformance CI fixes (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48999, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#47517, @fristonio)
* operator: Do not emit warning when deleting already deleted unmanaged pod (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48907, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48765, @gandro)
* operator: fix `metrics list` default address to work on IPv6-only clusters with dual stack nodes by trying both IPv4 and IPv6 loopback addresses (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48907, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48780, @41ks)
* Set ipv6 routing rules when dual stack is enabled (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49336, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49188, @fcrespofastly)
* Sockets are no longer destroyed when a Service backend is terminated unless they are still connected to that backend. Unconnected UDP sockets, and sockets that have since disconnected or moved to another backend, used to have their local port silently changed. (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49189, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48725, @maxskokov)

**CI Changes:**
* [ci] fix escaping in conformance ginkgo (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49189, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48991, @nebril)
* [v1.20] .github: Remove the EKS cluster pool workflows (cilium/cilium#49084, @aanm)
* ci: Add support for OIDC (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49317, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49007, @aanm)
* ci: cleanup disk space in documentation workflow (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48907, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48427, @tklauser)
* ci: Drop the empty floating tag line from CI image digests (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49189, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49070, @aanm)
* ci: fix CNI setup and readiness checks in the kubespray job (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49336, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48927, @aanm)
* ci: Give Envoy Embedded conformance a bigger runner (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49189, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49018, @aanm)
* ci: keep UDPRouteWeightedRouting skipped in the profile job (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49189, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49005, @aanm)
* ci: login to docker registry for downgrade image wait (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49189, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48983, @nebril)
* ci: Name runner variables after their Ubuntu release and let Renovate bump them (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49317, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49065, @aanm)
* ci: Skip redundant setup when base images already exist (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49317, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#47209, @HadrienPatte)
* ci: Stop passing secrets to the base images workflow (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49317, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49082, @aanm)
* gha/conformance-multi-pool: use the local fake external targets (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48986, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48558, @aanm)
* gha/e2e-upgrade: gate the after-agent-restart conn-disrupt check (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48437, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#47440, @aanm)
* gha/setup-aks-cluster: Retry a create that never starts (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49317, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48924, @aanm)
* gha: Derive the LVH package cache key once per run (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48986, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48656, @aanm)
* gha: don't fail PR tests on reporting errors (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49317, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48740, @aanm)
* gha: Grant id-token to the post-release call of release.yaml (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49317, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49323, @aanm)
* gha: make external fake targets image configurable (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49189, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48941, @giorio94)
* gha: Retry stalled kind image pulls before the install wait expires (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49336, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48989, @aanm)
* gha: Skip the duplicate CI image build on push to main (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48986, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48736, @aanm)
* gha: survive a GKE zone running out of capacity (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48986, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48184, @aanm)
* gha: Tolerate cosign and SBOM failures on pull requests (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48986, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48737, @aanm)
* ginkgo: remove `Test NodePort with L7 policy` tests (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49067, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#46499, @smagnani96)
* loadbalancer/tests: Fix the graceful termination test restart (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49317, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48939, @aanm)
* Migrate Conformance Cluster Mesh workflow to use fake external targets (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48654, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48250, @giorio94)

change_sections.heading: Release notes
items: alibabacloud: support IMDSv2 (token-based) instance metadata access (Backport PR cilium/cilium 49336, Upstream PR cilium/cilium 49182, @4n4nd)

Fix conntrack garbage collection deleting CT entries that the datapath reopened between the GC batch read and the delete, which could cascade into NAT mapping deletion and SNAT source-port reallocation for live connections. (Backport PR cilium/cilium 49119, Upstream PR cilium/cilium 46750, @gyutaeb)
operator: prevent CNPs with nodeSelector from silently enforcing nothing (Backport PR cilium/cilium 49173, Upstream PR cilium/cilium 47882, @weizhoublue)

azure: Fixed an issue where an interface with an empty MAC field would be reported back the the cilium agent causing it to crash on startup when trying to configure the routes. (Backport PR cilium/cilium 49336, Upstream PR cilium/cilium 48648, @41ks)
bpf: icmp: use 576 byte of inner packet to avoid partial csum floor (Backport PR cilium/cilium 48907, Upstream PR cilium/cilium 48578, @tommyp1ckles)
cilium-dbg: Print port numbers correctly for map cilium lb reverse sk (Backport PR cilium/cilium 49336, Upstream PR cilium/cilium 47134, @jayl1e)

daemon: fix a bug where L7 DNS policies could remain loaded in the datapath during agent shutdown, causing pods under a wildcard toFQDNs policy to lose DNS resolution for the duration of the restart. (Backport PR cilium/cilium 48907, Upstream PR cilium/cilium 48747, @41ks)
endpoint/restore: skip cleanup for reserved internal endpoints (Backport PR cilium/cilium 48999, Upstream PR cilium/cilium 48272, @fristonio)
envoy: handle listener additional address changes (Backport PR cilium/cilium 48917, Upstream PR cilium/cilium 48712, @nezdolik)
envoy: handle listener address changes in ADS (Backport PR cilium/cilium 48917, Upstream PR cilium/cilium 48798, @nezdolik)
envoy: track coalesced ADS snapshot updates (Backport PR cilium/cilium 48917, Upstream PR cilium/cilium 48631, @nezdolik)
Fix Gateway API ExternalAuth dropping request bodies when allowedResponseHeaders is unset (Backport PR cilium/cilium 49189, Upstream PR cilium/cilium 48770, @kirgene)

items.title: Cilium v1.19.9
items.summary: Summary of Changes
items.release_notes:
Summary of Changes
------------------

**Bugfixes:**
* endpoint/restore: skip cleanup for reserved internal endpoints (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49000, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48272, @fristonio)
* Fix incorrect deletion of new endpoint during GC iteration when reusing ID from a previously GC'd endpoint (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49176, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48905, @fristonio)
* Fix ip6tables chain rename errors being silently ignored during iptables rule reconciliation. (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49334, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49024, @maxskokov)
* Fix rare data race in selector cache that could lead to agent panic (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49176, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#47733, @odinuge)
* Fix restoration of terminating backends. If a terminating backend become active again during restart the backend was incorrectly kept as quarantined. (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48796, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48763, @joamaki)
* gateway-api: filter CEC controls from infrastructure metadata (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48985, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#47732, @nezdolik)
* L7 conformance CI fixes (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49000, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#47517, @fristonio)
* operator: Do not emit warning when deleting already deleted unmanaged pod (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48908, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48765, @gandro)

**CI Changes:**
* [ci] fix escaping in conformance ginkgo (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49176, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48991, @nebril)
* [v1.19] .github: Remove the EKS cluster pool workflows (cilium/cilium#49085, @aanm)
* ci: Add support for OIDC (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49316, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49007, @aanm)
* ci: cleanup disk space in documentation workflow (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48908, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48427, @tklauser)
* ci: Drop the empty floating tag line from CI image digests (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49176, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49070, @aanm)
* ci: fix CNI setup and readiness checks in the kubespray job (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49334, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48927, @aanm)
* ci: Give Envoy Embedded conformance a bigger runner (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49176, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49018, @aanm)
* ci: login to docker registry for downgrade image wait (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49176, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48983, @nebril)
* ci: Name runner variables after their Ubuntu release and let Renovate bump them (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49316, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49065, @aanm)
* ci: Skip redundant setup when base images already exist (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49316, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#47209, @HadrienPatte)
* ci: Stop passing secrets to the base images workflow (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49316, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49082, @aanm)
* gha/conformance-multi-pool: use the local fake external targets (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48987, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48558, @aanm)
* gha/setup-aks-cluster: Retry a create that never starts (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49316, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48924, @aanm)
* gha: Derive the LVH package cache key once per run (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48987, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48656, @aanm)
* gha: don't fail PR tests on reporting errors (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49316, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48740, @aanm)
* gha: Grant id-token to the post-release call of release.yaml (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49316, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#49323, @aanm)
* gha: make external fake targets image configurable (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49176, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48941, @giorio94)
* gha: Retry stalled kind image pulls before the install wait expires (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49334, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48989, @aanm)
* gha: Skip the duplicate CI image build on push to main (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48987, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48736, @aanm)
* gha: survive a GKE zone running out of capacity (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48987, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48184, @aanm)
* gha: Tolerate cosign and SBOM failures on pull requests (Backport PR cilium/cilium#48987, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48737, @aanm)
* loadbalancer/tests: Fix the graceful termination test restart (Backport PR cilium/cilium#49316, Upstream PR cilium/cilium#48939, @aanm)

**Misc Changes:**
* [v1.19] Bump various go modules (cilium/cilium#48768, @ferozsalam)
